runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W4W) Sat behind midfield 2 wide, raced keenly, made some ground in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W4W) 居中間之後位置，走第二疊。搶口。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(+) (1W1W1W2W) Sat worse than midfield, traveled smoothly, responded fairly well when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(+)(1W1W1W2W) 居中間之後位置，走勢暢順。對催策反應不俗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Tracked pace, chased leaders from top of home straight, stayed on well, gradually closing down winner final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 跟隨領放馬。自直路初起追趕領先馬匹。保持佳勢，最後一百米逐漸追近頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (3W3W2W4W) Sat midfield 2 wide, stayed on fairly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(3W3W2W4W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。末段保持一般走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W2W) Switched off to race at the rear of the field over 10Ls back middle stages, steadied 300M when commencing to finish off the race, had to change lane but the final effort was just fair.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W2W) 留居後列。中段落後逾十個馬位。三百米處在開始衝刺之際收慢。末段須轉換跑線，但衝刺僅屬一般。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W2W2W2W2W) Sat worse than midfield, raced keenly in the early and middle stages, no clear run until 200M, could not be fully tested.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W2W2W2W2W) 居中間之後位置，早段及中段搶口。未能望空直至二百米處，未能全力施為。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W2W) Jumped only fairly, sat in front of midfield, traveled nicely, made steady ground late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之前位置，走勢良佳。末段穩步上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(+) (1W1W1W1W) Jumped well, raced better than midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, angled out after passing 350M, hit the front 200M, kept on very well to the line and scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(+)(1W1W1W1W) 出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。跑過三百五十米處後向外移出。二百米處取得領先，保持甚佳走勢至終點，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Tracked pace, ridden and made effort 400m out, no extra and lost ground final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 跟隨領放馬。受催策，四百米處發力。最後二百米再無餘力，失地。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W) Began well, raced better than midfield on the outside, slightly improved after passing 600M, 2nd turning in, kept on well early in straight, peaked 100M, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W) 出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走外疊。跑過六百米處後略為推進。入直路時居第二位。直路初保持佳勢。一百米處未能再增速。其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W1W1W1W1W1W) Average to begin, sent forward to take the lead, challenged by rival turning in, headed 250M, kept on well until approaching 50M, weakened gradually close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W1W1W1W1W1W) 出閘普通，受催策上前領放。入直路時受對手挑戰。二百五十米處被超越，保持佳勢直至趨近五十米處。接近終點時逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W2W2W) Bumped shortly after start, raced prominently, 2 wide, challenged the leader 600M, kept on well in straight to take 2nd without threatening the winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W2W2W) 起步後不久發生碰撞，居前列，走第二疊。六百米處挑戰領放馬。直路上保持佳勢，跑獲亞軍，但未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (3W4W) Jumped awkwardly, sat rear, failed to respond under whip (See Incident Report).
(Blood at the right nostril.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(3W4W) 出閘笨拙，居後列。對鞭策毫無反應。（見競賽事件報告。）
（右邊鼻孔有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Jumped well, raced 2 wide better than midfield, 4 lengths back turning in, peaked early in straight, one-paced thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後四個馬位。直路初未能再增速。其後保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W1W1W) Bumped shortly after start, raced behind midfield on the inside, saved ground throughout, showed limited response early in straight, weakened gradually final 100M. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 起步後不久碰撞對手，居中間之後位置，走內疊。沿途走內疊節省腳程。直路早段對催策反應平平。最後一百米逐漸轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W3W2W2W) Shared the lead, weakened over the concluding stages, finished off only fairly (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W3W2W2W) 並排領先。末段轉弱。衝刺僅屬一般。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (2W2W2W3W) Mid-field, stayed on under pressure, snatched third on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(2W2W2W3W) 居中間位置。在催策下保持走勢。過終點時跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (1W1W1W1W) Towards rear, improved between rivals to challenge 150m out, stayed on and not beaten far.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(1W1W1W1W) 居後列。在對手之間上前，一百五十米處展開挑戰。保持走勢，所負不遠。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W2W) Mid-field, looking to improve when short of room 300m out to 200m out, unable to quicken once clear, lost ground final 50m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W2W) 居中間位置。三百米處至二百米處之間在空位不足下嘗試推進，但望空後未能加速。最後五十米失地。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W1W) Settled midfield on the rail, closed off fairly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。衝刺一般。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W3W3W2W) Tracked pace, three wide, weakened final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W3W3W2W) 跟隨領放馬，走第三疊。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(+) (1W1W1W1W) Began well from gate 9, sent forward to take the lead, led by 3/4L turning in, peaked and headed 200M, kept on evenly to take 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(+)(1W1W1W1W) 自第九檔出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。入直路時領先四分三個馬位。二百米處未能再增速，被超越。末段保持穩勢，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Pushed along to be racing closely behind leaders, couldn't sustain run passing 350M, weakened towards the finish. (No Vet findings.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 受推策，緊隨領先馬匹。跑過三百五十米處時後勁不繼。末段轉弱。（賽後接受獸醫檢查，並無發現任何明顯異常之處。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(+) (1W1W1W1W) Jumped well, sent forward to take the lead, enjoyed the easy lead to turn, peaked and headed 200M, stayed on evenly to take 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(+)(1W1W1W1W) 出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。直路彎前輕鬆領放。二百米處未能再增速及被超越。末段保持穩勢，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W) Chased leader after jumping from draw 13, briefly led early straight but soon couldn't keep up with pursuing rivals, faded to finish 6th.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W) 自第十三檔躍出後追趕領放馬。直路早段一度領先，但瞬即未能抗衡緊追的對手。力竭，取得第六名。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Soon led from a poor draw, gradually shifted across for rails run over 1200M out, led until joined early in home straight, unable to sustain effort inside final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 自外檔出閘，瞬即領放。千二米處逐漸切入內欄。領先至直路初被追及。最後一百米無以為繼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W1W) Made running, ridden over 200m out, closed down final 100m, headed on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 帶頭競跑。二百米處受催策。最後一百米被追近。過終點時被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(-) (1W1W1W1W) Showed good speed to lead, kept on but no threat to winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(-)(1W1W1W1W) 展現甚快前速，取得領先。保持走勢，但未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W2W2W) Moderately away, raced in 2nd, 2 wide, same position on turn, showed limited response early in straight, kept on same pace until approaching final 50M, weakened gradually thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W2W2W) 出閘普通，居第二位，走第二疊。直路彎居相同位置。直路早段對催策反應平平。保持同速直至趨近最後五十米，其後逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W3W) Shifted out at start and made contact, raced 2 wide in midfield, there to turn, one-paced in the run home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W3W) 起步時向外斜跑，發生觸碰，居中間位置，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。末段保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to fast; (2W4W) Began awkwardly, raced 2 wide behind midfield, 6 to 7 lengths back turning in, failed to close off in straight.
(Lame in left front leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏快步速;(2W4W) 出閘笨拙，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後六至七個馬位。直路上衝刺乏力。
（左前腿不良於行。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W2W2W3W) Sat on pace 2 wide, hung out in the home turn, one pace when asked. (See incident report.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W2W2W3W) 跟隨領放馬，走第二疊。直路彎外閃。在催策下保持同速。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W2W2W) Commenced well, raced 2 wide in midfield early, dropped towards rear 600M, 4 lengths or so back turning in, closed off well without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W2W2W) 出閘迅速，早段居中間位置，走第二疊。六百米處墮居後列。入直路時落後約四個馬位。末段衝刺良佳，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (4W3W) Jumped awkwardly, held up, last entering home straight, passed a few under pressure late on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(4W3W) 出閘笨拙，留後。入直路時居包尾位置。末段在催策下超越數匹對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W2W) Average to begin, raced in midfield, 3 lengths or so back turning in, kept on same pace in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W2W) 出閘普通，居中間位置。入直路時落後約三個馬位。直路上保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W5W) Dropped out from widest draw, pushed along widest into home straight, ran on well final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W5W) 自最外檔出閘後墮後。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。最後二百米以佳勢上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Squeezed out shortly after start, in rear, headway from 300m out after forced to wait for room briefly, no threat to leaders but staying on when running out of room closing stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 起步後不久受擠迫，居後列。須一度等待空位出現，其後自三百米處起追前。末段空位不足，保持走勢，但未能威脅領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Away fast to take the lead, took them along at steady pace middle stages, headed by rivals nearing 200M, no extra final stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，取得領先。中段以平穩步速領放。接近二百米處時被對手超越。末段再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(-) (1W1W1W1W) Away well, sent forward to take the lead, challenged by rival from 600M, kept on well early in straight, peaked and headed 200M, weakened gradually close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(-)(1W1W1W1W) 出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。自六百米處起受對手挑戰，直路早段保持佳勢，二百米處未能再增速及被超越，接近終點時逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Shifted in at start, raced better than midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, kept on well early in straight, peaked 200M, weakened gradually thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 起步時向內斜跑，居中間之前位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初保持佳勢。二百米處未能再增速。其後逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) Began smartly from gate 13, raced prominently on the outside, there to turn, peaked on run 300M, weakened gradually thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 自第十三檔出閘迅速，居前列，走外疊。直路彎前居相同位置。三百米處未能再增速，其後逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Made running, pressed in front, headed over 300m out, soon weakened.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 帶頭競跑。在領放下受追迫。三百米處被超越。瞬即轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Mid-field, shifted off rail early in home straight, failed to respond to pressure, weakened.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置。直路初移離內欄。對催策毫無反應，轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) In rear after slow start, ridden 400m out, some late inroads, never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 出閘緩慢，居後列。四百米處受催策。末段略為追前。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Never better than midfield, found nothing in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 從未超越中間位置。直路上再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W4W) Sat towards rear, traveled fairly, minor progress made when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W4W) 居後列，走勢一般。在催策下略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Began awkwardly and bumped, raced towards rear on the inside, 6 lengths back turning in, made good progress in straight without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘笨拙，被碰撞，居後列，走內疊。入直路時落後六個馬位。直路上追前甚多，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Waited with in rear, had to wait for run turning into home straight, unable to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 居後列，留力候上。轉入直路時須等待空位出現。未能展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W4W4W5W) Raced towards the rear, never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W4W4W5W) 居後列。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (4W5W) Raced very wide in rear without cover, some headway on bend, pushed along wide into home straight, ran on well but no match for winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(4W5W) 居後列，走大外疊，沒有遮擋。直路彎略為追前。入直路時受推策，走外疊。衝刺良佳，但未能抗衡頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (1W1W) Sat behind mid, traveled nicely, responded nicely when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(1W1W) 居中間之後位置，走勢良佳。末段對催策反應良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Bumped exiting stalls, driven along and outpaced early stages, pushed along widest into home straight, made up some late ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 出閘時發生碰撞，早段受催策，但未能跟上步速。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W2W4W5W) Moderately away, raced in midfield on the outside, made contact near 700M, peaked turning in, weakened early in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W2W4W5W) 出閘普通，居中間位置，走外疊。接近七百米處時發生觸碰。入直路時未能再增速，直路早段轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W7W) Did not show sufficient pace early stages to hold a more forward position as intended, made a wide move from the rear at middle of the turn before closing off fairly in the straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W7W) 早段未能展現足夠前速以佔取如賽前部署般較為靠前的位置。直路彎中段沿外疊自後列發力上前，其後在直路上衝刺一般。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Well there from a poor draw, came to share the pace rounding home bend gaining slender lead upon straightening, led until finding no extra 150M out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 自外檔出閘，居好位。轉直路彎時上前並排領先。入直路時領先些微距離。領先直至一百五十米處再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W1W) Ridden along to lead until 1200M, weakened inside 200M, never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 在催策下領放至千二米處。最後二百米轉弱。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W2W2W) Out with rest, raced 2 wide slightly behind midfield, 7 lengths or so back turning in, kept on same pace in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W2W2W) 與對手同步出閘，居中間稍後位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後約七個馬位。直路上保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Driven along and outpaced early stages, in rear, struggled to hold position from 600m out, well held from 300m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 早段受催策，被拋離，居後列。自六百米處起難以保持位置。自三百米處起遙遙落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W1W1W) Taken back from a wide draw, raced at rear on the inside, saved ground on turn, peaked early in straight, weakened final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W1W1W) 自外檔出閘，留居包尾位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初未能再加速。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W2W) Across from widest draw to press leader, under pressure 300m out, weakened.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W2W) 自大外檔出閘後切入，追迫領放馬。三百米處受催策。末段轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W4W) Bumped out of stalls, three wide in mid-field, ridden top of home straight, sticking to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W4W) 出閘時發生碰撞。居中間位置，走第三疊。直路初受催策，持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W3W) Sat midfield 2 wide, under pressure from the 500M, weakened soon after.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W3W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。自五百米處起受催策，其後瞬即轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W3W3W) Began only fairly, raced behind midfield on outer, hampered near 700M, 4 lengths back turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W3W3W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置，走外疊。接近七百米處時受阻礙。入直路時落後四個馬位。直路早段未能再增速，其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Checked at the 800M, sat last, picked off a few weakened rivals.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 八百米處勒避，居包尾位置。末段超越數匹已轉弱的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Commenced well, raced 2 wide slightly behind midfield, 6 lengths or so back turning in, failed to make any progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 出閘迅速，居中間稍後位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後約六個馬位。直路上毫無進展。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (2W2W) Began well from a tricky gate, raced prominently on the outside, 1/4L back turning in, kept on well early in straight, peaked 200M, weakened thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
(Respiratory condition.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(2W2W) 自第九檔出閘迅速，居前列，走外疊。入直路時落後四分一個馬位。直路早段保持佳勢，二百米處未能再增速，其後轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）
（有呼吸毛病。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W2W1W) Sat last 2 wide, never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W2W1W) 居包尾位置，走第二疊。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W2W1W) Settled in worse than midfield, saved ground turning in for home but dropped out tamely.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W2W1W) 居中間之後位置。轉入直路時走內疊節省腳程，但乏力墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W) Sat at the rear 2 wide, never involved.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W) 居後列，走第二疊。從未參與競逐。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Sat last, picked off a couple weakened rivals.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居包尾位置。末段超越兩匹已轉弱的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W5W) Held up from wide draw, under pressure in last turning into home straight, soon well held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W5W) 自最外檔出閘，留後。轉入直路時居包尾位置，受催策。瞬即落後甚遠。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Average to begin, raced 3 wide with cover in midfield, there to turn, peaked early in straight, weakened gradually thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 出閘一般，居中間位置，走第三疊，有遮擋。直路彎前居相同位置。直路初未能再增速。其後逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W2W3W) Raced in touch with leaders, driven along 550m out, outpaced and left behind in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W2W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹。五百五十米處受催策。直路上未能跟上步速，被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W2W4W) Hampered shortly after start, raced behind midfield on the outside, very wide turning in, made minor progress in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W2W4W) 起步後不久受阻礙，居中間之後位置，走外疊。入直路時走大外疊。直路上略為追前。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W2W3W) Made contact shortly after start, raced 2 wide, 4 lengths or so back, weakened 500M, eased thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W2W3W) 起步後不久與對手互相觸碰，落後約四個馬位，走第二疊。五百米處轉弱，其後收慢。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W1W1W1W1W1W) Jumped okay and led, traveled okay, weakened at the top of the Straight (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W1W1W1W1W1W) 出閘尚可，領放，走勢不俗。直路初轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W1W2W) Tracked leading pair, ridden to chase leader from top of home straight, stuck to task but unable to bridge gap.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W1W2W) 跟隨領先兩駒。自直路初起在催策下追趕領放馬。持續力拼，但未能收窄距離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Waited with towards rear, had to wait for run turning into home straight, passed a few tiring rivals.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 居後列，留力候上。入直路時須等待空位出現。末段超越數匹漸呈疲態的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Fast; (3W5W) Out in line, raced behind midfield on outer, 4 lengths back turning in, showed no response early in straight, weakened and eased final 300M. (See Racing Incidents.)
(Roarer again.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
快步速;(3W5W) 與對手同步出閘，居中間之後位置，走外疊。入直路時落後四個馬位。直路初對催策毫無反應。最後三百米轉弱及收慢。（見競賽事件報告。）
（再次患有喘鳴症。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Fast; (1W1W1W1W) Bumped shortly after start, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter.
(Roarer again.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 起步後不久發生碰撞，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路早段未能再增速，其後轉弱。
（再次患有喘鳴症。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Slow; (1W1W) Average to begin, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, no clear run early in straight, cleared after passing 300M, failed to make any progress thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
(Roarer again.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘一般，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路早段未能望空。跑過三百米處後望空，其後毫無進展。（見競賽事件報告。）
（再次患有喘鳴症。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W2W) Bumped and lost balance out of stalls, tracked leaders against rail, switched for clear run 500m out, dropped away quickly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W2W) 出閘時被碰撞及失去平衡，跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。五百米處轉換跑線以望空。末段迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W3W3W) Jumped with them, raced in midfield on the outside early, moved closer after passing 1250M, positioned 3 wide, a length or so back in the middle stages, there to turn, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W3W3W) 與對手同步出閘，早段居中間位置，走外疊。跑過一千二百五十米處後追近。中段落後約一個馬位，走第三疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路初未能再加速，其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W) Waited with towards rear, short of room early in home straight, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W) 居後列，留力候上。直路初空位不足。速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (2W2W2W4W) Slowly away, taken back to race at tail, very wide turning in, made good progress in straight to make frame.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(2W2W2W4W) 出閘緩慢，留居包尾位置。入直路時走大外疊。直路上追前甚多，取得第四名。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W2W3W) Bumped shortly after start, raced at rear on the outside, very wide turning in, made some progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W2W3W) 起步後不久發生碰撞，居後列，走外疊。入直路時走大外疊。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Slowly away and lost four lengths, always well in rear.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 出閘緩慢，落後四個馬位。全程遙居於後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W2W2W3W) Began only fairly, raced behind midfield on the inside, angled out 1100M, slightly improved in the middle stages, 1 to 2 lengths back turning in, kept on evenly in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W2W2W3W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置，走內疊。千一米處向外移出，中段略為推進。入直路時落後一至兩個馬位，直路上保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(-) (1W1W1W1W) Taken back from a wide draw, raced towards rear on the inside, saved ground on turn, made some headway in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(-)(1W1W1W1W) 自外檔出閘後留居後列，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W1W2W4W) Crowded and bumped at start, rail position in mid-field, angled out to make run 450m out, ran on well but no match for winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W1W2W4W) 起步時受擠迫及發生碰撞，居中間位置，走內欄。四百五十米處向外移出推進。末段保持佳勢，但不敵頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Taken back to race behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, made some progress early in straight, peaked 150M, weakened gradually thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 留居中間之後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路早段略為追前。一百五十米處未能再增速，其後逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Made running, headed 300m out, weakened.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 沿途領放。三百米處被超越，轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W) Awkward start, rail position in mid-field, unable to hold position on bend, well beaten.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W) 出閘笨拙，居中間位置，走內欄。直路彎未能保持位置，潰敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Very fast; (3W2W2W2W) Led or disputed lead early stages, gradually settled about 3L off the pace 2-wide in 2nd in back straight, became 2L 3rd around home bend, folded up quickly upon straightening.
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
極快步速;(3W2W2W2W) 早段領先或爭奪領先。對面直路上逐漸居第二位，落後領放馬約三個馬位，走第二疊。轉直路彎時居第三位，落後兩個馬位。入直路時迅速力竭。
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Showed good speed to lead, disputed led on bend, headed by winner 550m out, weakened quickly final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 展現甚快前速，取得領先。直路彎爭奪領先。五百五十米處被頭馬超越。最後二百米迅速轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W3W) Settled in mid-field, under pressure to hold position from 800m out, dropped away quickly in home straight, well beaten.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W3W) 居中間位置。自八百米處起受催策以保持位置。直路上迅速墮退，洩氣潰敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(+) (2W2W) Prominent on outside of leader, quickened to lead 300m out, headed by winner 50m out and no extra, lost second on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(+)(2W2W) 居領放馬外側的前列位置。加速上前，三百米處取得領先。五十米處被頭馬超越，再無餘力。終點線上失去亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Raced in touch with leaders, short of room top of home straight, dropped away quickly final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹。直路初空位不足。最後二百米迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Sluggish start, dropped in from wide draw, travelling okay top of home straight but still in rear, pushed along, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 自大外檔起步緩慢，移入內疊。直路初走勢尚可，但仍居後列。末段受推策。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W4W) Tracked pace, wide throughout, weakened final 400m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W4W) 跟隨領放馬。沿途走外疊。最後四百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Began well from a wide draw, raced in midfield on the outside, no cover for the majority of the race, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 自外檔出閘迅速，居中間位置，走外疊，大部分途程沒有遮擋。直路早段未能再增速，其後轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Bumped out of stalls, across to track leaders against rail, well placed into home straight, moved smoothly into contention 300m out, strong run to get up on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 出閘時發生碰撞，切入以跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。入直路時居好位。三百米處順勢上前挑戰。走勢強勁，過終點時僅勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Keen early, tracked leading pair, challenged from 200m out, upsides winner and every chance 100m out, no extra.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 早段搶口，跟隨領先兩駒。自二百米處起展開挑戰。一百米處追上頭馬，一度甚具爭勝機會，但其後再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W4W) Sat towards the rear 2 wide, swung wide on the turn, made no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W4W) 居後列，走第二疊。直路彎移出外疊。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W2W) Began well enough, raced keenly early stages and ended up settling outside the lead, held 2nd spot from 500M to 200M and had no extra late stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W2W) 出閘不俗，早段搶口，其後居領放馬外側。自五百米處起至二百米處保持居第二位。末段再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W4W) Sat at the rear, picked off a few weakened rivals.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W4W) 居後列。末段超越數匹已轉弱的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W5W) Taken back from a wide draw, raced at rear on the outside, very wide turning in, one-paced in the run home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W5W) 自外檔出閘後留居後列，走外疊。入直路時走大外疊。末段保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W2W) Began only fairly, raced behind midfield on the inside, 2 wide from 500M, no clear run early in straight, found daylight 200M, finished off well to take a place.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置，走內疊。自五百米處起走第二疊。直路早段未能望空，二百米處望空。末段衝刺良佳，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Dropped back from wide draw, settled near the rear and 6Ls off leader 400M, made some progress and wasn't beaten far at the finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 自大外檔出閘後墮居後列。四百米處落後領放馬六個馬位。末段略為追前，過終點時所負不遠。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W3W) Rail position in rear of mid-field, some headway on bend, stayed on but never going pace to challenge leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W3W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。直路彎略為追前。末段保持走勢，但從未能加速以挑戰領先馬匹。

formguide.comments_eng: Australian PPG, a 4-year-old gelding, by Toronado from Wawail, a daughter of Lonhro. Horses by the same sire include Helios Express and Little Paradise. This fellow was given six trials for one placing in Hong Kong. He shared the lead and finished third under the whip, beaten by 1L, over 1200m on turf in Conghua on September 28. In the latest trial, he sat midfield and finished fifth under pressure, beaten by 4-3/4Ls, over 1200m AWT at Sha Tin on October 13. He is not looking like a first-start winner here.
formguide.comments_chi: 「豪華房車」(Toronado)之後，在港同父馬包括「驕陽明駒」及「小鳥天堂」等駒，生母出自「白金礦」(Lonhro)。抵港後六次試閘一次上名。9月28日出試從化草地1200米，早段並頭領放，末段鞭策下跑第三名，落後頭馬一個馬位。最近10月13日出試田泥1200米，早段居中，末段力策下跑第五名，落後頭馬4.75個馬位。初出應未能構成威脅。

formguide.comments_eng: New Zealand PPG, a 4-year-old gelding, by Per Incanto from Luscious Legs, a daughter of Pins. Horses by the same sire include Raging Blizzard and A Americ Te Specso. This fellow was given seven trials for one placing in Hong Kong. He raced handily and finished second under pressure, beaten by a neck, over 1200m AWT at Sha Tin on February 16. In the latest trial, he sat midfield and finished fifth under pressure, beaten by 1-3/4Ls, over 1200m on turf in Conghua on September 28. Prefer to take a watching brief to see how he shapes at his local debut.
formguide.comments_chi: Per Incanto之後，在港同父馬包括「精算暴雪」及「有財有勢」等駒，生母出自Pins。抵港後七次試閘一次上名。2月16日出試田泥1200米，早段居前競跑，末段力策下跑第二名，落後頭馬一馬頸位。最近9月28日出試從化草地1200米，早段居中，末段力策下跑第五名，落後頭馬1.75個馬位。初出暫宜觀望。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W3W) Sat at the rear 2 wide, never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W3W) 居後列，走第二疊。從未能構成威脅。

formguide.comments_eng: Australian PPG, a 4-year-old gelding, by Fierce Impact from Under The Stars, a daughter of Snitzel. He will be the first runner of his sire in Hong Kong. This fellow was given three trials in Hong Kong. In the latest trial, he sat last and finished fourth under pressure, beaten by 5Ls, over 1200m AWT at Sha Tin on October 6. He will probably need a run.
formguide.comments_chi: Fierce Impact之後，是此父系首匹在港上陣馬，生母出自「犀利時」(Snitzel)。抵港後試閘三次。最近10月6日出試田泥1200米，早段居包尾位置，末段力策下跑第四名，落後頭馬五個馬位。首戰熱身為主。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W3W) From gate 13 sat handy with cover within striking distance of the leader, momentarily hit the front 250M out, boxed on nicely just unable to hold off late challengers.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W3W) 自第十三檔出閘，居前列，落後領放馬不遠，有遮擋。二百五十米處一度取得領先。以佳勢力拼，但末段未能抗衡對手的挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W5W) Taken back from the widest draw, raced behind midfield on the outside, travelled keenly in the middle stages, 4 lengths or so back turning in, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W5W) 自大外檔出閘，留居中間之後位置，走外疊。中段搶口。入直路時落後約四個馬位。末段以穩勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W3W) Settled midfield 2 wide, raced keenly throughout, made no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W3W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。沿途搶口。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) One of quickest away from the stalls, raced keenly in the early stages, held up for a short distance early part of the straight, knuckled down to the task once clear.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 出閘最快馬匹之一。早段搶口。直路早段在一段短途程上受困。末段望空後瞬即力拼上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Jumped with them, raced slightly behind midfield the inside, 5 lengths back turning in, made little progress in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間稍後位置，走內疊。入直路時落後五個馬位。直路上略為追前。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W) Bounded as stalls opened and lost ground, in rear, good headway halfway out, outpaced and left behind final 300m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W) 出閘時向上跳躍及失地，居後列。半程時追前甚多。最後三百米未能跟上步速，被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W5W) Settled in mid-field, keen middle stages, commenced move out wide 600m out, bumped and lost balance 500m out, no extra final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W5W) 居中間位置。中段搶口。六百米處開始上前，走外疊。五百米處發生碰撞及失去平衡。最後二百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W3W) Prominent early dropping over 2L back to joint 4th rounding home bend, one-paced in straight in the run to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W3W) 早段居前列。轉直路彎時墮後逾兩個馬位，並居第四位。直路上衝刺時保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W3W) Tracked pace, a bit outpaced 500m out, tended to hang right top of home straight, stayed on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W3W) 跟隨領放馬。五百米處略為被拋離。直路初傾向內閃。保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to slow; (2W2W1W) Taken back from the widest draw, raced at tail, 7 lengths back turning in, made some progress early in straight, weakened final 100M. (See Racing Incidents.)
(Lame in right front leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏慢步速;(2W2W1W) 自大外檔出閘，留居包尾位置。入直路時落後七個馬位。直路初略為追前。最後一百米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）
（右前腿不良於行。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W2W2W) Raced in touch with leaders, switched for clear run 300m out, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W2W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。三百米處轉換跑線以望空，但速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Jumped well, raced prominently on the inside, 1/2L back turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened final furlong. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，居前列，走內疊。入直路時落後半個馬位。直路初未能再加速。最後二百米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W2W3W) Raced in rear, struggled to hold position final bend, pushed along widest into home straight, lost touch final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W2W3W) 居後列。直路彎難以保持位置。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。最後二百米被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Slow; (1W1W) Began only fairly, raced behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, kept on same pace in straight.
(Lame in right front leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上保持同速。
（右前腿不良於行。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (3W2W2W) Headway to race on leaders' quarters before halfway, challenged 300m out, every chance until no extra final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(3W2W2W) 上前，半程前居領先馬匹外側競跑。三百米處展開挑戰，一度甚具爭勝機會，直至最後一百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Jumped with them, raced prominently on the stands' side, hard ridden approaching 300M, kept on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;與對手同步躍出，居前列，靠近外欄競跑。趨近三百米處時受力策。保持穩勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(-) (2W1W) From draw 14 showed good pace early stages, went forward setting fast tempo, headed by pursuing rivals near 200M, faded late stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(-)(2W1W) 自第十四檔出閘，早段展現甚快前速，上前以甚快步速領放。接近二百米處時被緊追的對手超越，末段力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(-) (2W2W) Sat outside the lead, kept on without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(-)(2W2W) 居領放馬外側。保持走勢，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; Began awkwardly and bumped, raced behind midfield on the middle track, hard ridden approaching 300M, kept on same pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;出閘笨拙及發生碰撞，居中間之後位置，在跑道中央競跑。趨近三百米處時受力策。保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(-) (1W2W) Sat on pace 2 wide, kept on to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(-)(1W2W) 居前列，走第二疊。末段保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W) Began smartly, took the lead, shared lead with rival in the middle stages, peaked and headed near 200M, weakened final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W) 出閘迅速，取得領先。中段與對手並排領先。接近二百米處時未能再增速及被超越。最後一百五十米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (4W2W1W1W) Sat on pace, weakened from the 600M. (Unacceptable Performance, must trial) (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(4W2W1W1W) 居前列。自六百米處起轉弱。（表現難以接受，必須試閘及格。）（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W1W) Jumped well and led, kept on until weakened final 75M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 出閘迅速，領放。保持走勢，最後七十五米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W) Broke well settling just off the pace in 2nd, came to join race leader rounding home bend holding every chance in straight until unable to sustain effort inside final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W) 出閘迅速，居領放馬稍後的第二位。轉直路彎時追上領放馬。直路上一度甚具爭勝機會，但最後一百五十米後勁不繼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Made all, kicked 300m out and three lengths clear 100m out, margin reduced closing stages but always doing enough.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 全程領放。三百米處加速。一百米處帶離三個馬位。末段領先距離收窄，但一直保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(+) (1W1W) Showed good pace to lead, kept on but no threat to winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(+)(1W1W) 前速甚快，取得領先。保持走勢，但未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Raced in rear, had to wait for run top of home straight, forced to steady 200m out, ran on well final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 居後列。直路初須等待空位出現。二百米處被迫收慢，其後走勢良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (1W1W) Sat midfield on the rail, made good ground in the Straight, just unable to hold off the winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。直路上追前甚多，僅未能抗衡頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Checked on jumping, sat rear, minor progress made when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 躍出時勒避，居後列。在催策下略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Jumped awkwardly, taken back to race at rear, travelled keenly after passing 800M, 3-1/2L back turning in, one-paced in the run home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘笨拙，留居後列。跑過八百米處後搶口。入直路時落後三個半馬位。直路上保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W3W5W) Settled in last few from a poor draw, never seen with a chance.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W3W5W) 自第十檔出閘，居最後數位之內。從未有力一爭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W1W) Slowly into stride from wide draw, raced in last place, pushed along and a bit detached 500m out, good late headway final 150m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W1W) 自外檔出閘緩慢，居包尾位置。受推策，五百米處稍被拋離。最後一百五十米追前甚多。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W2W) Soon dropped to last few from a wide barrier, never seen with a chance.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W2W) 自外檔出閘，瞬即墮居最後數位之內。從未有力一爭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Slowly away, raced towards rear, headway from halfway, hampered briefly 250m out, stayed on, no threat to winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘緩慢，居後列。自半程起追前。二百五十米處一度受阻礙。保持走勢，未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W2W) Sat last, made headway final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W2W) 居包尾位置。最後一百米追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W2W) Set towards rear on the rail, weakened in the home turn then eased. (See incident report.)
(Bled.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W2W) 居後列，走內欄。直路彎轉弱，其後收慢。（見競賽事件報告。）
（流鼻血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Settled in front of rear 3 wide, never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 居後列，走第三疊。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W4W) Bumped start, raced at rear on outer, 6 lengths or so back, very wide into straight, failed to make any progress in the run home. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W4W) 起步時發生碰撞，居後列，落後約六個馬位，走外疊。入直路時走大外疊。末段毫無進展。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W) Jumped only fairly, raced towards rear on the inside, moved a bit closer on turn, no daylight early in straight, made some progress thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，居後列，走內疊。直路彎略為追近。直路初未能望空。其後略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W2W) Crowded on jumping, raced in midfield on the inside, 2 wide turning in, showed limited response early in straight, weakened gradually final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W2W) 躍出時受擠迫，居中間位置，走內疊。入直路時走第二疊。直路早段對催策反應平平。最後一百米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W2W) Sat towards rear, always at the back, not much found.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W2W) 沿途居後列。末段無甚餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W4W) Taken back form gate 13, raced at rear on the outside, very wide turning in, failed to close off in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W4W) 自第十三檔出閘，留居後列，走外疊。入直路時走大外疊。直路上衝刺乏力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Jumped with them, raced behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, passed some tired runners in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間之後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上超越數匹已呈疲態的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Made contact shortly after start, taken back to race at rear on the inside, saved ground on turn, made no progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 起步後不久與對手互相觸碰，留居後列，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上未能追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Slowly away, raced at rear throughout, never a factor.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘緩慢。沿途居包尾位置。從未有力一爭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(+) (1W1W) Chased leader along the inside in a race being run very slowly in the middle stages, lacked winner's acceleration passing 400M, just kept to the task in the run home for 3rd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(+)(1W1W) 追趕領放馬，走內疊，賽事中段步速非常緩慢。跑過四百米處時加速力不及頭馬。末段僅保持走勢，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W1W) Made contact at start, raced behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, made no impression in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 起步時發生觸碰，居中間之後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) Began only fairly, raced 2 wide towards rear, there to turn, no clear run and made contact early in straight, cleared 300M, made no progress thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，居後列，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路早段未能望空，與對手互相觸碰。三百米處望空，其後毫無進展。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W4W) Waited with towards rear, pushed along widest into home straight, made up some late ground but never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W4W) 居後列，留力候上。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。末段略為追前，但從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Jumped only fairly and settled near the rear, pushed wide after 600M before running home fairly in the straight. Never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 出閘僅屬一般，居後列。過了六百米處後受推策，走外疊。直路上衝刺一般。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W2W3W) Out with rest, raced 2 wide better than midfield, 3 wide turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W2W3W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。入直路時走第三疊。直路早段未能再增速。其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Away with them, raced 3 wide with cover behind midfield, 2 wide on turn, made little progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 與對手同步出閘，居中間之後位置，走第三疊，有遮擋。直路彎走第二疊。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(+) (1W2W) Sat off pace on the rail, angled out in the Straight, closed off nicely, just no match to the winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(+)(1W2W) 居領放馬之後，走內欄。直路上向外移出。末段衝刺良佳，僅未能抗衡頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Not the quickest out, sat worse than midfield on the rail, made no impression. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 出閘並非最快，居中間之後位置，走內欄。毫無表現。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (1W4W) Reserved in midfield 6Ls off the steady pace, switched to 3-wide making the turn for home, quickened up impressively from 400M, led mid-straight before powering away to win by big margin.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(1W4W) 留居中間位置，落後步速平穩的領放馬六個馬位。轉直路彎時移至第三疊。自四百米處起加速凌厲。直路中段取得領先。其後帶離對手，大勝而回。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Sat towards the rear 2 wide, angled out in the Straight, stayed on well, just missed.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居後列，走第二疊。直路上向外移出。保持佳勢，僅敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Settled in last few, obtained a clear run 300M out, ran on well inside final 200M past beaten runners closing stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 居最後數位之內。三百米處望空。最後二百米以佳勢上前。末段超越數匹已洩氣潰敗的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W4W) Sat midfield, traveled okay, switched out at the Turn, made steady progress when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W4W) 居中間位置，走勢尚可。直路彎向外移出。在催策下以穩勢追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Jumped with them, raced 2 wide towards rear, 7 lengths back turning in, made good progress in straight without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 與對手同步躍出，居後列，走第二疊。入直路時落後七個馬位。直路上追前甚多，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W2W3W4W) Wide in mid-field, dropped to rear and looked to be struggling top of home straight, stayed on late, never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W2W3W4W) 居中間位置，走外疊。直路初墮居後列，看似掙扎上前。末段保持走勢，從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W3W) Settled in front of midfield on the rail, angled out rounding the Home Turn, closed off strongly to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W3W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。轉直路彎時向外移出，末段衝刺強勁，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (2W2W2W2W3W5W) Jumped only fairly, sat towards rear, made the Turn wide, responded nicely when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(2W2W2W2W3W5W) 出閘僅屬一般，居後列。轉彎時走外疊，對催策反應良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W2W6W) Sat towards rear, switched out rounding the Turn, ran on evenly (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W2W6W) 居後列。轉直路彎時向外移出。走勢平穩。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W1W1W) Jumped only fairly, sat handy, traveled okay, closed off nicely.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，居前列，走勢尚可。末段衝刺良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W2W2W3W) Sat at the rear, only able to pass weakened rivals.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W2W2W3W) 居後列。僅能超越已轉弱的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W1W2W) Slightly slow out, raced slightly behind midfield on the inside, 3 lengths or so back turning in, no clear run until approaching final 50M, made some progress thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W1W2W) 出閘稍慢，居中間稍後位置，走內疊。入直路時落後約三個馬位。未能望空直至趨近五十米處。其後略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W2W) Sat midfield on the rail, never in contention.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W2W) 居中間位置，走內欄。從未有力一爭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Bumped start, raced at rear on the inside, last turning in, failed to make any progress in straight, unacceptable performance.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 起步時發生碰撞，居後列，走內疊。轉入直路時居包尾位置。直路上毫無進展。表現難以接受。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Bumped exiting stalls, waited with towards rear, dropped to last place top of home straight, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘時被碰撞，居後列，留力候上。直路初墮居包尾位置。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W1W2W) Held up last, still in last place top of home straight, switched inside for clear run 200m out, never going pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W1W2W) 留居包尾位置。直路初仍居包尾位置。二百米處移入內疊以望空。從未能加速以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W2W2W) Sat handy, traveled fairly, closed off well but held up at the finishing stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W2W2W) 居前列，走勢一般。衝刺良佳，但末段受困。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W2W3W3W) Tracked pace, improved to challenge 300m out, led 200m out, ran on strongly to go clear final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W2W3W3W) 跟隨領放馬。三百米處上前展開挑戰，二百米處取得領先。最後一百米走勢強勁，帶離對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Across from wide draw to lead, headed 300m out, no extra final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 自外檔出閘，切入領放。三百米處被超越。最後二百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Settled in midfield, made steady headway under pressure after straightening, did best work late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 居中間位置。入直路後在催策下穩步上前。末段表現最佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W5W) Sat towards rear, angled out at the Turn, ran on evenly (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W5W) 居後列。直路彎向外移出。以穩勢上前。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W3W3W) Sat last, held up rounding the Home Turn, picked off a few weakened rivals. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W3W3W) 居包尾位置。轉直路彎時受困。超越部分已轉弱的對手。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W4W) Jumped well from gate 13, taken back to race 2 wide behind midfield, angled out 450M, 5 lengths or so back turning in, made good progress in straight to take a place.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W4W) 自第十三檔出閘迅速，留居中間之後位置，走第二疊。四百五十米處向外移出。入直路時落後約五個馬位。直路上追前頗多，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Sat outside the lead, weakened final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居領放馬外側。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (4W3W) Ridden along to race prominently, raced wide throughout, stayed on well in home straight, lost out narrowly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(4W3W) 在催策下居前列，沿途走外疊。直路上保持佳勢。以短距離之差落敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W) Made contact shortly after start, raced better than midfield on the outside, 1-1/2L back turning in, kept on well in straight to take 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W) 起步後不久發生觸碰，居中間之前位置，走外疊。入直路時落後一個半馬位。直路上保持佳勢，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Mid-field, one paced under pressure when short of room and forced to switch around 200m out, stayed on after, unable to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，在催策下保持同速，空位不足。約二百米處被迫向外移出。其後保持走勢，未能追及領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Slow; (3W4W) Caught 3 wide in front of midfield, raced greenly in the Straight. (See Incident Report)
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
慢步速;(3W4W) 居中間之前位置，走第三疊。直路上走勢稚嫩。（見競賽事件報告。）
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W4W) Travelled in midfield 3-wide with cover, slightly worse around home bend and given reminders entering straight, kept on under pressure without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W4W) 居中間位置，走第三疊，有遮擋。轉直路彎時稍為墮後，入直路時受鞭策。在催策下保持走勢，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W2W2W) Settled behind midfield on the rail, limited response when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W2W2W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。對催策反應平平。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W2W5W) Held up, plenty to do when pushed along 400m out, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W2W5W) 留後。四百米處受推策時落後甚遠。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W2W) Taken back from the outside gate, settled midfield on the rail, closed off without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W2W) 自大外檔出閘後留後，居中間位置，走內欄。末段展開衝刺，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (1W1W) Sluggish early despite ridden along, improved steadily on rail to reach midfield 1200M out, switched for a clear run over 200M out and quickened well to snatch victory final strides.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(1W1W) 儘管受催策，但早段走勢遲緩。沿欄穩步上前，千二米處進佔中間位置。二百米處轉換跑線以望空。以佳勢加速，最後數步取得勝利。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (2W2W2W5W) Settled midfield, traveled okay, made some progress when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(2W2W2W5W) 居中間位置，走勢不俗。在催策下略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W4W) Jumped with them, raced in midfield on the outside, 4 to 5 lengths back turning in, kept on same pace in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W4W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間位置，走外疊。入直路時落後四至五個馬位。直路上保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W5W) Sat midfield 3 wide, showed some dash top of the Straight and kept on to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W5W) 居中間位置，走第三疊。直路初略為加速上前，保持走勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W4W) Raced 3 wide no cover off midfield, weakened in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W4W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。直路上轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(+) (2W2W3W4W) Settled midfield, traveled comfortably, switched out rounding the Turn, closed off nicely (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(+)(2W2W3W4W) 居中間位置，走勢暢順。轉直路彎時向外移出。末段衝刺良佳。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W3W2W) Held up from wide draw, pushed along 500m out, stayed on final 150m, unable to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W3W2W) 自外檔出閘，留後。五百米處受推策。最後一百五十米保持走勢，但未能追近領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W6W) Dropped in from wide draw, ridden to try and make ground wide on bend, stayed on late, never a threat to leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W6W) 自外檔出閘後移入內疊。直路彎在催策下嘗試推進，沿外疊追前。末段保持走勢。從未能威脅領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W3W3W3W) Caught 3 wide no cover behind midfield, never involved. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W3W3W3W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。從未參與競逐。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (2W6W) Away well but soon restrained to a rearward position, travelled well into home turn and made solid progress from 600M, ran home strongly final stages and just prevailed in a close finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(2W6W) 出閘迅速，但瞬即受約束，居後列。進入直路彎時走勢良佳。自六百米處起追前甚多。末段衝刺強勁，在與亞軍馬匹幾乎齊過終點下僅勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W2W3W3W4W4W) Jumped only fairly, sat worse than midfield, made steady progress late (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W2W3W3W4W4W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置。末段穩步追前。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W3W) Settled just off midfield 2 wide, shuffled back in the middle stages, no clear run early part of the Straight, closed off once in the clear. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W3W) 居中間稍後位置，走第二疊。中段墮居後列。直路早段未能望空，望空後隨即衝刺。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Sat in front of midfield 2 wide, closed off okay.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居中間之前位置，走第二疊。末段衝刺不俗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W2W2W) Tracked leader, ridden and outpaced 400m out, stayed on final 150m, tight for room between rivals closing stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W2W2W) 跟隨領放馬。四百米處受催策，被拋離。最後一百五十米保持走勢。末段在馬匹之間受緊迫。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (2W2W) Jumped with them, raced 2 wide in midfield, there to turn, closed off well to take a place.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(2W2W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間位置，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。衝刺良佳，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Sat 3 wide behind midfield, closed off nicely, no threat to top 2.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊。末段衝刺良佳，但未能威脅首兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W2W) Crowded at start settling in midfield, baulked briefly for a run over 350M out, finished off the race well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W2W) 起步時受擠迫，居中間位置。三百五十米處一度受困。末段衝刺良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Very slow; (2W3W) Settled in front of midfield, not much impression made (See Incident Report).
(Lame in left front leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
極慢步速;(2W3W) 居中間之前位置。無甚表現。（見競賽事件報告。）
（左前腿不良於行。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Soon recovered to midfield in 7th along the rail after moderate start, gained one better to 6th inside the 800M, kept on well inside final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 出閘普通，瞬即恢復走勢，居中間第七位，走內欄。八百米處追前一位至第六位。最後一百米保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Away awkwardly, reserved behind midfield along the inside, couldn't quicken passing 400M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 出閘笨拙，留居中間之後位置，走內疊。跑過四百米處時未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W3W) Always rear, forced to check 900M out dropping to last, made no further impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W3W) 一直居後列。九百米處被迫勒避，墮居包尾位置。再無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(-) (1W1W) Sat worse than midfield on the rail, stayed on okay.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(-)(1W1W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。末段保持不俗走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W4W) Jumped fairly, given a reserved ride near the rear, still 8Ls to make up 400M, closed off moderately to claim 5th but was never likely.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W4W) 出閘一般，居後列，留力候上。四百米處仍落後八個馬位。衝刺普通，取得第五名，但從未有力一爭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W4W) Taken back from the widest draw, raced behind midfield on the outside, slightly improved on turn, showed limited response early in straight, weakened inside final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W4W) 自大外檔出閘，留居中間之後位置，走外疊。直路彎略為推進上前。直路早段對催策反應平平。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W2W) Crowded shortly after start, raced 2 wide slightly behind midfield, 4 lengths back turning in, one-paced in the run home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W2W) 起步後不久受擠迫，居中間稍後位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後四個馬位。末段保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Very fast; (3W2W2W4W) Jumped only fairly, settled handy, failed to respond when asked (See Incident Report).
(Lame in right hind leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
極快步速;(3W2W2W4W) 出閘僅屬一般，居前列。對催策毫無反應。（見競賽事件報告。）
（右後腿不良於行。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W3W) Began only fairly, raced 2 wide at rear, 6 to 7 lengths back turning in, made minor progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W3W) 出閘僅屬一般，居後列，走第二疊。入直路時落後六至七個馬位。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (4W4W) Waited with towards rear, taken wider 900m out without cover, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(4W4W) 居後列，留力候上。九百米處被帶出較外疊，沒有遮擋。速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W1W4W4W) Taken back to race at tail, 6 lengths or so back turning in, taken wide in straight and made very good progress to be nearest on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W1W4W4W) 留居包尾位置。入直路時落後約六個馬位。直路上移出外疊，追前甚多，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W2W) Jumped only fairly, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, showed limited response early in straight, no clear run near 150M, kept on same pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路早段對催策反應平平。接近一百五十米處時未能望空，保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (4W4W3W2W2W1W) Ridden hard to sit handy, raced wide in the early stages until near the 1000M, gave ground notably from the Back Straight (Unacceptable Performance, Must BT).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(4W4W3W2W2W1W) 在力策下居前列。早段走外疊直至接近一千米處。自對面直路起顯著墮退。（表現難以接受。必須試閘及格。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W3W) Mid-field, struggling to hold position final bend, dropped away.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W3W) 居中間位置。直路彎難以保持位置。墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W4W5W) Forced wider on the track early stages and shuffled back to last 8Ls or so off the leader, made up several places out wide 800m out, soon tired out early in the straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W4W5W) 早段被迫走較外疊，墮居包尾位置，落後領放馬約八個馬位。八百米處追前數位，走外疊。直路初瞬即力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W2W2W) Crowded at start, held up last, still in last place top of home straight, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W2W2W) 起步時受擠迫，留居包尾位置。直路初仍居包尾位置。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W4W) Waited with towards rear in rail position, switched wide on bend for clear run, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W4W) 居後列，留力候上，走內欄。直路彎移出外疊以望空。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Sat behind the leaders on the rail, weakened and faded in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 居領先馬匹之後，走內欄。直路上轉弱及力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Sat on pace, gave ground in the Straight. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居前列。直路上墮退。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W3W2W2W) Average to begin, raced 3 wide with cover in midfield, 2 wide from 900M, 6 lengths back in the middle stages, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W3W2W2W) 出閘一般，居中間位置，走第三疊，有遮擋。自九百米起走第二疊。中段落後六個馬位。直路初未能再增速。其後轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W2W) Shifted out at start and bumped, raced better than midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, angled out 450M, showed limited response early in straight, weakened inside final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W2W) 起步時向外斜跑及被碰撞，居中間之前位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。四百五十米處向外移出。直路初對催策反應平平。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Made running, headed over 300m out, faded final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 帶頭競跑。三百米處被超越。最後二百米力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(-) (3W2W2W2W) Sat outside the leader, kept on but no threat to winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(-)(3W2W2W2W) 居領放馬外側。保持走勢，但未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W1W1W1W) Sat on pace, traveled fairly, not much impression made.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W1W1W1W) 居前列，走勢一般。無甚表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W) Sat outside the leader, nothing in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W) 居領放馬外側。直路上毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W2W1W1W) Made running, challenged 700m out, remained in share of lead until 400m out, faded.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W2W1W1W) 領放。七百米處受挑戰。四百米處前仍並排領先。末段力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W3W) Tracked leaders three wide, keen, effort over 300m out, faded final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走第三疊，搶口。三百米處發力。最後二百米力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Jumped well, sent forward to take the lead, headed approaching 700M, retook the lead 500M, kept on very well in straight and won by a length. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，受催策上前，取得領先。趨近七百米處時被超越。五百米處再度取得領先。直路上保持甚佳走勢，以一個馬位之先掄元。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (5W3W6W6W) Dropped out from wide draw, commenced move out wide 900m out, unable to improve position, left behind in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(5W3W6W6W) 自最外檔出閘後墮後。九百米處開始上前，走外疊。未能推進，直路上被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W2W) Began well, raced in 2nd, 2 wide, challenged the leader turning in, peaked 200M, weakened final 50M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W2W) 出閘迅速，居第二位，走第二疊。入直路時挑戰領放馬。二百米處未能再增速。最後五十米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W3W) Sat on pace, switched out rounding the Turn, hampered at the top of the Straight, not much progress made.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W3W) 居前列。轉直路彎時向外移出。直路初受阻礙。無甚進展。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Towards rear after slow start, stayed on into mid-field but never going pace to get competitive.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 起步緩慢，居後列。末段保持走勢，進佔中間位置，但從未能加速以爭勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Waited with towards rear, had to wait for run turning into home straight, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 居後列，留力候上。轉入直路時須等待空位出現。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W2W3W) Settled towards the rear, failed to respond from home turn and soon out of contention. Finished tailed out. (Jockey - failed to travel at any stage of the event / No Vet findings.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W2W3W) 居後列。自直路彎起對催策毫無反應，瞬即再無爭勝機會。包尾大敗而回。（騎師表示，坐騎全程走勢欠佳。）（賽後接受獸醫檢查，並無發現任何明顯異常之處。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) From wide draw taken back to last, over 10Ls off the pace in middle stages, got left behind turning home. Soundly beaten. (No Vet findings.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 自外檔出閘後留居包尾位置。中段落後領放馬逾十個馬位。轉入直路時被拋離。大敗而回。（賽後接受獸醫檢查，並無發現任何明顯異常之處。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Rail position in mid-field, ridden to hold position from 500m out, no extra final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。自五百米處起受催策以保持位置。最後二百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W2W3W) Settled in mid-field, struggled to hold position final bend, eased when detached 100m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W2W3W) 居中間位置。直路彎難以保持位置。一百米處被拋離時收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W3W) Three wide in mid-field, struggled to hold position on bend, gave ground final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W3W) 居中間位置，走第三疊。直路彎難以保持位置。最後二百米墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Began well, raced 2 wide slightly better than midfield, there to turn, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 出閘迅速，居中間稍前位置，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路初未能再增速，其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W4W) Three wide in mid-field, hung out on bend, left behind in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W4W) 居中間位置，走第三疊。直路彎外閃。直路上被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Prominent early stages, gradually drifted some 2L back to 4th onto course proper, came under pressure to hold place inside final the 300M, weakened steadily closing stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;早段居前列。跑離分支直路時逐漸墮居第四位，落後約兩個馬位。最後三百米受催策以保持位置。末段逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Ridden along to lead, unable to hold position from 400m out, eased once well held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;在催策下取得領先。自四百米處起未能保持位置。遙遙落後時隨即收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (2W4W) Jumped with the field, settled at the rear of midfield one off the fence, kicked strongly in the final 200M under reminders to grab rivals in the final stride.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(2W4W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。最後二百米在催策下加速強勁，最後一步追過對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W3W) Settled in front of midfield, traveled wide, hampered when being taken wider inside 300M, not much impression made.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W3W) 居中間之前位置，走外疊。三百米處在被帶出較外疊之際受阻礙。無甚表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Shifted out and lost ground leaving stalls, rail position in mid-field, hampered against rail 800m out, gave ground in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘後向外斜跑及失地，居中間位置，走內欄。八百米處沿欄受阻礙。直路上墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (3W4W) Broke well from a wide barrier but taken backward to behind midfield 3-wide, taken wider into straight, obtained a clear run 300M out and ran on well to be nearest at finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(3W4W) 自外檔出閘迅速，但留居中間之後位置，走第三疊。入直路時移出更外疊。三百米處望空，以佳勢追前。過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Broke well from a wide barrier before gradually settling in 8th for cover just inside the 1100M, slightly further back in quickened pace 800M out, ran on steadily inside final 400M without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 自外檔出閘迅速。跑過千一米處後逐漸居第八位以取得遮擋。八百米處略為進一步落後步速加快的領放馬。最後四百米穩步上前，未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Sat midfield on the rail, made little impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。無甚表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W4W) Bumped shortly after start, waited with towards rear, pushed along wide into home straight, made up some late ground but never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W4W) 起步後不久發生碰撞，居後列，留力候上。入直路時受推策，走外疊。末段略為追前，但從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Jumped well before being restrained to a midfield position 4-5Ls off the pace, fought on steadily final 400M but was always held by leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘迅速，其後受約束，居中間位置，落後領放馬四至五個馬位。最後四百米持續力拼，但一直落後領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Jumped awkwardly and lost ground, ended up racing at the rear group, had some work to do top of the straight but couldn't quicken enough.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘笨拙及失地，居後列。直路初仍落後頗遠，但加速力不足。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (4W4W) Raced in rear, headway out wide 800m out, ridden 400m out, ran on well but no threat to leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(4W4W) 居後列。八百米處追前，走外疊。四百米處受催策，以佳勢上前，但未能威脅領先馬匹。

formguide.comments_eng: Australian PPG, a 4-year-old gelding, by Maurice from Mysterious Light, a daughter of Fantastic Light. Horses by the same sire include Mr Cool and Mighty Profit. The fellow was given four trials in Hong Kong. In the latest trial, he sat not far off the pace and finished fourth under pressure, beaten by 2Ls, over 1200m on turf at Happy Valley on October 9. He will probably need a run.
formguide.comments_chi: 「滿樂時」(Maurice)之後，在港同父馬包括「紅衣醒目」及「滿利時」等駒，生母出自「奇異光芒」(Fantastic Light)。抵港後試閘四次。最近10月9日出試谷草1200米，早段落後領先馬匹不遠，末段力策下跑第四名，落後頭馬兩個馬位。首戰熱身為主。

formguide.comments_eng: Australian PPG, a 4-year-old gelding, by Showtime from Two Carats, a daughter of Verrazano. Horses by the same sire include Meowth and Young Arrow. The fellow was given four trials for one placing in Hong Kong. He shared the lead and finished third under the whip, beaten by 3/4L, over 1200m AWT at Sha Tin on September 8. In the latest trial, he raced handily and finished fourth under pressure, beaten by 3/4L, over 1200m on turf in Conghua on October 5. Prefer to take a watching brief to see how he shapes at his local debut.
formguide.comments_chi: 「表演時間」(Showtime)之後，在港同父馬包括「喵喵怪」及「競駿非凡」等駒，生母出自「大探險家」(Verrazano)。抵港後四次試閘一次上名。9月8日出試田泥1200米，早段並頭領放，末段鞭策下跑第三名，落後頭馬0.75個馬位。最近10月5日出試從化草地1200米，早段居前競跑，末段力策下跑第四名，落後頭馬0.75個馬位。初出暫宜觀望。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Bumped out of stalls, rail position in rear of mid-field, eased and switched 200m out, ran on strongly final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘時發生碰撞，居中間之後位置，走內欄。二百米處收慢及轉換跑線。最後二百米以勁勢追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W2W) Sat last, never involved.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W2W) 居包尾位置。從未參與競逐。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W1W1W) Taken back from gate 13, raced at rear on the inside, saved ground on turn, one-paced in the run home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W1W1W) 自第十三檔出閘，留居後列，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。末段保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Fast; (1W1W2W3W) Sat last, made no ground. (See Incident Report)
(Multi-limb lameness.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
快步速;(1W1W2W3W) 居包尾位置。未能追前。（見競賽事件報告。）
（多肢不良於行。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (2W2W2W4W) Mustered no early pace and settled 3rd last about 15Ls or so off the leader 600m out, peeled out widest turning in for home, stormed home to score with sufficient speed in the race.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(2W2W2W4W) 欠缺前速，居尾三位置，六百米處落後領放馬約十五個馬位。入直路時移出最外疊。賽事步速頗快，末段衝刺凌厲，取得勝利。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W1W) Waited with in rear, severely checked 400m out when trying to improve, lost all chance and allowed to coast home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W1W) 居後列，留力候上。四百米處在嘗試推進之際大力勒避。其後再無爭逐機會，獲許順其自然地競跑至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W2W2W) Sat last, able to pick off weakened rivals.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W2W2W) 居包尾位置。末段超越已轉弱的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W2W2W3W) Settled towards rear on the inside, angled out of a run on straightening, ran on quite well under pressure without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W2W2W3W) 居後列，走內疊。入直路時向外移出取位。在催策下走勢不俗，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W) Made contact at start, raced 2 wide slightly behind midfield early, found rail near 750M, 5Ls or so back turning in, failed to close off in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W) 起步時發生觸碰，早段居中間稍後位置，走第二疊。接近七百五十米處時移入內欄。入直路時落後約五個馬位。直路上衝刺乏力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Away with them, raced 2 wide slightly behind midfield, 4 lengths back turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 與對手同步出閘，居中間稍後位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後四個馬位。直路早段未能再增速，其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Began only fairly, raced at rear on the inside, saved ground on turn, showed some response early in straight, peaked 200M, kept on same pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，居後列，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路早段對催策略有反應。二百米處未能再增速。保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Shifted out at start and made contact, raced towards rear on the stands' rail, made no progress final 400M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;起步時向外斜跑，與他駒互相觸碰，居後列，走外欄。最後四百米毫無進展。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Broke fairly, settled slightly worse than midfield on the rail, no daylight until the last 100M, stayed on fairly well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘一般，居中間稍後位置，走內欄。未能望空直至一百米處。其後保持不俗走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Settled near the rear 2 wide, closed off okay.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居後列，走第二疊。末段衝刺不俗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Jumped awkwardly and slowly away, in rear, minor headway late, never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 出閘笨拙及緩慢，居後列。末段略為追前。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W) From wide draw given a waiting ride towards the rear 3-wide, had 6Ls to make up 400M, closed off fastest and not far behind the minor placegetters.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W) 自外檔出閘，留力待上，居後列，走第三疊。四百米處落後六個馬位。末段衝刺最快，落後入位馬匹不遠。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Moderately away from gate 1, raced slightly better than midfield on the inside, 3 lengths back turning in, kept to inside after straightening and made some progress. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘普通，居中間稍前位置，走內疊。入直路時落後三個馬位。入直路後持續走內疊，略為追前。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Bumped leaving stalls, mid division, travelled smoothly into home straight, stayed on but never going pace to get competitive.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘時發生碰撞，居中間位置。入直路時走勢暢順。保持走勢，但從未能加速以爭勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Settled in mid-field, well placed and every chance from 400m out, unable to quicken, gave ground final 100m.
(Roarer again.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 居中間位置。自四百米處起居好位，一度甚具爭勝機會。末段未能加速，最後一百米墮退。
（再次患有喘鳴症。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Ridden forward after moderate start to within 2L of pace in 3rd or 4th, switched off rail for a run shortly after straightening but unable to quicken to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 出閘普通，受催策上前，居第三或第四位，落後領放馬不逾兩個馬位。入直路後不久移離內欄以取位，但未能加速以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (2W2W) Prominent early from a low draw, gradually drifted backward to midfield approaching first turn, baulked for a run just inside the 400M, quickened well to hit the front over 100M out only to be collared final strides.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(2W2W) 自內檔出閘，早段居前列。趨近首個彎位時逐漸墮居中間位置。跑過四百米處後受困。末段加速良佳，一百米處取得領先，僅於最後數步被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W2W) Moderate start, gradually recovered to midfield in 8th or 7th on rail, improved to 6th some 4L back on home bend, fought on under pressure to reach 2nd 100M out but without threatening the winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W2W) 起步一般，其後逐漸恢復走勢，居中間第七或第八位，走內欄。直路彎推進至第六位，落後約四個馬位。在催策下力拼，一百米處進佔第二位，但未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(-) (2W1W) Average to begin, raced in 2nd, 3/4L back turning in, hard ridden from 300M but only showed limited response, weakened gradually inside final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(-)(2W1W) 出閘一般，居第二位。入直路時落後四分三個馬位。自三百米處起受力策，但反應僅屬平平。最後二百米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Sat towards rear on the rail, saved ground on the turn, kept on fairly in the straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居後列，走內欄。直路彎走內欄節省腳程。直路上保持一般走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (4W3W) Broke well but soon taken back to last and waited with while travelling keenly, did not find much room between runners until running on too late inside the 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(4W3W) 出閘迅速，但瞬即留居包尾位置，留力候上，搶口。在馬匹之間空位不足，一百米處追前，但為時已晚。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W3W) Settled midfield, raced wide, stayed on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W3W) 居中間位置，走外疊。末段保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W) Began well from gate 12, taken back to race towards rear on the outside, very wide turning in, made very good progress in straight to take 2nd, nearest finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W) 自第十二檔出閘迅速，留居後列，走外疊。入直路時走大外疊。直路上追前甚多，跑獲亞軍。過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (5W2W3W) Held up last, still in last pair top of home straight, passed a few tiring rivals late on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(5W2W3W) 留居包尾位置。直路初仍居最後兩位之內。末段超越數匹已呈疲態的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W2W2W) Keen and pressed leader, one of three that raced clear to halfway, weakened 200m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W2W2W) 搶口，追迫領放馬。為半程前拋離馬群的三駒之一。二百米處轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Sat midfield, traveled smoothly, ran on evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居中間位置。走勢暢順。以穩勢追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W2W) Sat on pace, ran on fairly. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W2W) 居前列。走勢一般。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(-) (2W3W) Crowded for room shortly after start, raced in rear, still plenty to do when checked briefly 350m out, stayed on strongly final 200m despite edging right.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(-)(2W3W) 起步後不久受擠迫，居後列。三百五十米處仍落後甚遠，一度勒避。最後二百米儘管曾內閃，但仍保持勁勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W2W) Dropped back from a wide draw, at the rear early stages before moving closer to midfield making the turn for room, closed off moderately final 300M without troubling leaders. (Held up near 100M.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W2W) 自大外檔出閘，留後。早段居後列，轉直路彎時追近至中間位置以取位。最後三百米衝刺普通，未能威脅領先馬匹。（接近一百米處時受困。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W3W) Moderately away from gate 9, raced 3 wide behind midfield, 6 lengths back turning in, made good progress in straight to be nearest on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W3W) 自第九檔出閘普通，居中間之後位置，走第三疊。入直路時落後六個馬位。直路上追前甚多。過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W4W) Ridden early before gradually dropping to midfield or slightly worse 3-wide, made no impression in the run to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W4W) 早段受催策，其後逐漸墮居中間或中間稍後位置，走第三疊。末段毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W3W) Held up, well held from top of home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W3W) 留後。自直路初起落後甚遠。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Sat in front of midfield 2 wide, ran on okay.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 居中間之前位置，走第二疊。走勢尚可。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W2W) Settled towards rear on rail after sluggish start, baulked behind runners between the 500 and 250M, made no further impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W2W) 出閘緩慢，居後列，走內欄。五百米處至二百五十米處之間在馬群之後受困。其後再無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W3W) Sat on pace 2 wide, under pressure from the 600M, weakened from the 400M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W3W) 居前列，走第二疊。自六百米處起受催策。自四百米處起轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Jumped awkwardly settling in 5th some 3L back, hampered and lost position over 700M out, met minor interference 400M out and dropped out noticeably.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘笨拙，居第五位，落後約三個馬位。七百米處受阻礙，失位。四百米處略為受干擾，顯著墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W3W) Began well from gate 12, raced prominently, 3 wide, there to turn, hit the front 150M, kept on well to the line and scored. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W3W) 自第十二檔出閘迅速，居前列，走第三疊。直路彎前居相同位置。一百五十米處取得領先。保持佳勢至終點，勝出賽事。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Prominent early, gradually drifted backward to 10th some 5L off the pace by the 800M, saved ground turning in for home, faded inside final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 早段居前列。逐漸墮後，八百米處居第十位，落後領放馬約五個馬位。轉入直路時走內疊節省腳程。最後一百五十米力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Moderately away from gate 1, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, showed limited response early in straight, weakened final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘普通，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初對催策反應平平。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Shifted in at start and made contact, raced better than midfield on the outside, no cover for the majority of the race, 3 lengths back turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened final 250M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 起步時向內斜跑，發生觸碰，居中間之前位置，走外疊。大部分途程沒有遮擋。入直路時落後三個馬位。直路初未能再加速。最後二百五十米轉弱。
