runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Tracked leader, chased along bend to hold position, dropped away quickly 400m out, eased once well held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領放馬。直路彎力追以保持位置。四百米處迅速墮退，遙遙落後時隨即收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (2W2W) Mid division, unable to secure clear run until 250m out, ran on strongly final 100m, unlucky.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(2W2W) 居中間位置。未能望空直至二百五十米處。最後一百米走勢強勁，但跑來欠運。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Prominent early stages, given reminders to hold pace from 800M out, produced good late impression inside final 150M.
(Lame in left front leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 早段居前列。自八百米處起受鞭策以保持步速。最後一百五十米追前甚多。
（左前腿不良於行。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Shifted in at start and bumped, raced 2 wide behind midfield, 4 to 5 lengths back turning in, kept on same pace in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 起步時向內斜跑及被碰撞，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後四至五個馬位。直路上保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Shifted in and bumped out of stalls, mid division, twice bumped 400m out to 350m out, stayed on well but no threat to winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘時向內斜跑及被碰撞，居中間位置。四百米處至三百五十米處之間兩度被碰撞。保持佳勢，但未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Commenced well, sent forward to take the lead, travelled keenly in the early stages, led by 1/2L turning in, peaked and headed 250M, weakened final 150M. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，受催策上前領放，早段搶口。入直路時領先半個馬位。二百五十米處未能再增速，被超越。最後一百五十米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W4W) Taken back from gate 13, raced towards rear on the outside, there to turn, made some headway in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W4W) 自第十三檔出閘，留居後列，走外疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) From wide draw shifted across behind runners, settled near last 5-6Ls back, failed to run on passing 400M. Never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 自外檔出閘後在馬群之後切入，居接近包尾位置，落後五至六個馬位。跑過四百米處時未能追前，從未能構成威脅。

formguide.comments_eng: Australian PPG, a 4-year-old gelding, by North Pacific from Splash Headline, a daughter of Manhattan Rain. He will be the first runner of his sire in Hong Kong. This fellow was given two trials for one placing in Hong Kong. He made the run and finished third under pressure, beaten by a neck, over 800m on turf in Conghua on September 21. In the latest trial, he shared the lead and finished fifth under pressure, beaten by 4Ls, over 1000m on turf in Conghua on October 5. He will probably need a run.
formguide.comments_chi: North Pacific之後，是此父系首匹在港上陣馬，生母出自「曼克頓雨」(Manhattan Rain)。抵港後兩次試閘一次上名。9月21日出試從化草地800米，早段領放，末段力策下跑第三名，落後頭馬一馬頸位。最近10月5日出試從化草地1000米，早段並頭領放，末段力策下跑第五名，落後頭馬四個馬位。首戰熱身為主。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(+) (3W1W) Ridden along from stalls to get across, kicked 400m out, headed by winner 150m out, stuck to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(+)(3W1W) 出閘後受催策，切入內疊。四百米處加速。一百五十米處被頭馬超越。其後保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) Mid-field, ridden along into home straight, weakened final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 居中間位置。入直路時受催策。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Slowly away, positioned 3 lengths behind the leader, hard ridden after passing 400M but only showed limited response, weakened final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;出閘緩慢，落後領放馬三個馬位。跑過四百米處後受力策，但反應僅屬平平。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W4W) Moderately away from gate 13, raced in midfield on the outside, no cover throughout, weakened early in straight when hard run took effect. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W4W) 自第十三檔出閘普通，居中間位置，走外疊，沿途沒有遮擋。耗力太多，直路初轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; Jumped with them, sent forward to take the lead, led by 1/4L at 400M, hard ridden from 350M, kept on well but unable to hold off the winner final 50M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;與對手同步躍出，受催策上前領放。四百米處領先四分一個馬位。自三百五十米處起受力策。保持佳勢，但最後五十米未能抗衡頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W2W) Tracked leader, ridden top of home straight to chase leader, one paced under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W2W) 緊隨領放馬。直路初在催策下追趕領放馬。末段在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Crowded at start, settled in rear of mid-field, pushed along wide into home straight, never a factor.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 起步時受擠迫，居中間之後位置。入直路時受推策，走外疊。從未有力一爭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Slow; (1W3W) Slowly away, raced at rear on the inside, difficult to settle in the middle stages, angled out 600M, made some progress in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
(Lame in right front leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
慢步速;(1W3W) 出閘緩慢，居後列，走內疊。中段難以穩定走勢。六百米處向外移出。直路上略為追前。（見競賽事件報告。）
（右前腿不良於行。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Sat rear, switched out rounding the Turn, had difficulty obtaining clear running near 200M, steady ground made from behind.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 居後列。轉直路彎時向外移出。接近二百米處時難以望空。末段自後列穩步追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (4W5W) Dropped out from wide draw, pushed along widest into home straight, raced green, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(4W5W) 自外檔出閘後墮後。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。走勢稚嫩，毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Taken back from a wide draw, raced at rear on the outside, still well back on turn, made very good progress in straight to be nearest on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 自外檔出閘後留居後列，走外疊。直路彎仍遙居於後。直路上追前甚多，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W6W) Waited with towards rear, raced wide throughout without cover, pushed along widest into home straight, never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W6W) 居後列，留力候上。沿途走外疊，沒有遮擋。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W) Settled behind midfield, checked shortly after the start, failed to travel thereafter, could not make ground (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W) 起步後不久勒避，居中間之後位置，其後走勢欠順。未能追前。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W3W) Sat midfield 2 wide, angled out into the straight, made good progress under whip, nearest at the finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W3W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。入直路時向外移出。在鞭策下追前頗多。過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W2W2W) Sat midfield 2 wide, responded well when asked over the final 150M, closed off nicely.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W2W2W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。最後一百五十米對催策反應良佳。末段衝刺良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Chased leader, challenged and every chance top of home straight, stayed on and lost second close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 追趕領放馬。直路初展開挑戰，已獲機會盡展所長。保持走勢。接近終點時失去亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W4W) Caught 3 wide no cover near midfield, weakened in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W4W) 居接近中間位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。直路上轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) Pressed forward from the widest barrier, positioned one-out-one-back rounding home bend, came under pressure upon straightening but faded inside final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 自最外檔出閘，受催策上前。轉直路彎時落後一個馬位，走第二疊。入直路時受催策，但最後一百五十米力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Behind after badly hampered leaving stalls, still in last place and plenty to do turning into home straight, stayed on final 300m, never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 出閘時嚴重受阻礙，其後居後列。轉入直路時仍居包尾位置，落後甚遠，最後三百米保持走勢。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Clean jump, raced 2 wide better than midfield, a length or so back turning in, took the lead approaching 200M, peaked and headed 150M, ran on evenly to the line. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘俐落，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後約一個馬位。趨近二百米處時取得領先。一百五十米處未能再增速，被超越。保持穩勢至終點。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Tracked pace, hung left under pressure final 200m and outpaced.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;跟隨領放馬。最後二百米在催策下外閃，被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; Settled in mid-field towards centre of course, effort 400m out, stayed on steadily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;居中間位置，靠近跑道中央競跑。四百米處受催策。末段保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; Tracked leaders against rail, short of room against rail from 400m out, unlucky.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;跟隨領先馬匹，走外欄。自四百米處起在外欄空位不足。殊不夠運。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Sat box-seat, one pace when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 居包廂位置。末段在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W2W) Sat behind midfield 2 wide, one pace when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W2W) 居中間之後位置，走第二疊。在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W3W) Sat behind the leaders on the rail, hung out rounding the Home Turn, eased down soon after. (Racing Manners Unacceptable, must trial) (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W3W) 居領先馬匹之後，走內欄。轉直路彎時外閃，其後瞬即收慢。（走勢難以接受，必須試閘及格。）（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W1W1W) Average to begin, raced in 3rd, 1 to 2 lengths back, 2nd on turn, made some progress early in straight, no extra final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W1W1W) 出閘一般，居第三位，落後一至兩個馬位。直路彎居第二位。直路早段略為追前，最後一百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W) Jumped with them, sent forward to take the lead, led by 3/4L turning in, kept on very well to the line and scored. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W) 與對手同步出閘。受催策上前，取得領先。入直路時領先四分三個馬位。保持甚佳走勢至終點，掄元。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Sat behind midfield 2 wide, one pace when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 居中間之後位置，走第二疊。受催策時保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W4W) Raced in touch with leaders, taken wider 600m out, briefly hampered 400m out, no extra final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W4W) 跟隨領先馬匹。六百米處被帶出較外疊。四百米處一度受阻礙。最後二百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W) Sat handy, raced wide, one pace to the line (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W) 居前列，走外疊。末段保持同速。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W3W) Began only fairly and made contact, raced 2 wide towards rear, 6 lengths or so back turning in, ran on evenly in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W3W) 出閘僅屬一般，與對手互相觸碰，居後列，走第二疊。入直路時落後約六個馬位。直路上保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; Slightly slow out and made contact shortly after start, positioned a length or so back, 2 away from the stands' rail, no clear run until approaching final 150M, made minor progress thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;出閘稍慢，其後不久與對手互相觸碰，落後約一個馬位，走外欄第三疊。未能望空直至趨近一百五十米處。其後略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W2W) Jumped only fairly, settled worse than midfield, made steady progress under whip.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置。在鞭策下穩步追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (5W3W3W) Three wide in mid-field without cover, good headway final bend, short-lived challenge early in home straight, no extra final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(5W3W3W) 居中間位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。直路彎以佳勢上前。直路初一度發力展開挑戰。最後一百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W3W3W) Ridden forward from the outside barrier, sat on pace 3 wide no cover, kept on okay.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W3W3W) 自大外檔出閘，受催策上前，居前列，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。末段走勢尚可。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W2W3W) Broke well and ridden early before settling in 3rd mostly within 2L of pace, commenced move home bend reaching 2nd into straight but unable to threaten the winner throughout.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W2W3W) 出閘迅速，早段受催策，其後大多居第三位，落後領放馬不逾兩個馬位。直路彎開始上前，入直路時進佔第二位，但沿途未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (5W3W4W) Settled down ahead of midfield but was caught racing wide without cover, responded well early straight and challenged for the lead but run ended 100M and faded.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(5W3W4W) 居中間之前位置，但走外疊，沒有遮擋。直路初對催策反應良佳，爭奪領先，但一百米處無以為繼，力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W2W) Began smartly, raced better than midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, angled out 350M, kept on well in straight to take 2nd without threatening the winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W2W) 出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。三百五十米處向外移出。直路上保持佳勢，跑獲亞軍，但未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Sat just behind the leaders, just one pace when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 居領先馬匹稍後位置。在催策下僅保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W1W) Began smartly, took the early lead, headed 1000M, positioned a length behind the leader in the middle stages, saved ground on turn, hit the front 150M, kept on well to the line and scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W1W) 出閘迅速，早段領放，一千米處被超越。中段落後領放馬一個馬位。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。一百五十米處取得領先。末段保持佳勢，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; Held up, switched towards centre of course 400m out, unable to quicken.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;留後。四百米處移向跑道中央。末段未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Raced wide throughout, disputed led on bend, headed by winner 550m out, dropped away quickly in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 沿途走外疊。直路彎爭奪領先。五百五十米處被頭馬超越。直路上迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W3W) Settled in mid-field, unable to pick up for pressure from 400m out, gave ground final 300m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W3W) 居中間位置。自四百米處起受催策，但未能加速。最後三百米墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W3W) Raced very wide throughout in rear, shuffled back 400m out, lost touch final 300m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W3W) 沿途居後列，走大外疊。四百米處墮後。最後三百米被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; Pressed leader, good progress to lead halfway out, pushed along over 300m out, on top from there, ran on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;追迫領放馬。追前甚多，半程時取得領先。三百米處受推策，其後保持領先。末段衝刺良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; Settled in mid-field, ridden along 400m out, stayed on well but hung out final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;居中間位置。四百米處受催策。保持佳勢，但最後二百米外閃。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Made contact shortly after start, positioned 1-1/2L behind the leader on the stands' rail, same position in the middle stages, not enough room until 150M, made some progress thereafter to take a place.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;起步後不久與他駒互相觸碰，落後領放馬一個半馬位，走外欄。中段居相同位置。空位不足直至一百五十米處。其後略為追前，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Mid division towards centre of course, pushed along halfway out, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;居中間位置，靠近跑道中央競跑。半程時受推策，速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Made contact with the right side of its starting gate, raced prominently, difficult to settle in the early stages, made contact 900M, 2 lengths back on turn, weakened early in straight, eased final 150M. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 出閘時觸碰閘廂右側，居前列。早段難以穩定走勢。九百米處發生觸碰。直路彎落後兩個馬位。直路早段轉弱，最後一百五十米收慢。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Settled in 9th spot but less than 3Ls away from leaders, couldn't keep up final 250M and dropped out of contention.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;居第九位，但落後領先馬匹不足三個馬位。最後二百五十米未能跟上，再無爭勝機會。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Bumped out of stalls, raced in rear of mid-field, switched towards centre of course 400m out, bumped 300m out, tight for room 150m out, stayed on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;出閘時發生碰撞，居中間之後位置。四百米處移向跑道中央。三百米處與對手互相碰撞。一百五十米處受緊迫。末段保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Settled in last few of bunched field, crowded 600M out dropping to second last rounding home bend, made up ground in straight, never nearer.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居馬群最後數位之內。六百米處受擠迫。轉直路彎時墮居尾二位置。直路上追前。以末段最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Settled in rear of mid-field, challenged and every chance from 300m out, unable to quicken.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;居中間之後位置。自三百米處起展開挑戰，一度極具爭勝機會，但未能增速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Slightly slow out, raced towards rear, hard ridden after passing 250M, finished off strongly to take 2nd, just beaten by a narrow margin. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;出閘稍慢，居後列。跑過二百五十米處後受力策。衝刺強勁，跑獲亞軍，僅以短距離之差見負。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Crowded shortly after the start and was taken across behind runners to race near the stand side, held up for clear running 300M-200M before closing off the race moderately.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;起步後不久受擠迫，在馬群之後切入，靠近外欄競跑。三百米處至二百米處之間受困而未能望空，其後衝刺普通。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; Sat at the rear 3 off the stands rail, shifted in to center track to improve, made some late ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;居後列，走外欄第四疊。向內移入至跑道中央以推進，末段略為追前。

formguide.comments_eng: Australian PPG, a 4-year-old gelding, by Toronado from Pussycat Dream, a daughter of Oasis Dream. Horses by the same sire include Helios Express and Little Paradise. He was given seven trials for one win and five placings in Hong Kong. He sat not far off the pace and finished fifth under pressure, beaten by 6-1/4Ls, over 1200m on turf in Conghua on September 18. In the latest trial, he raced in midfield early and quickened up willingly on his own in the straight to score by a short head, over 1000m on turf in Sha Tin on October 13. He looks a nice horse and could run well here on debut.
formguide.comments_chi: 「豪華房車」(Toronado)之後，在港同父馬包括「驕陽明駒」及「小鳥天堂」等駒，生母出自「綠洲夢」(Oasis Dream)。抵港後七次試閘得一勝五次上名。9月18日出試從化草地1200米，早段落後領先馬匹不遠，末段力策下跑第五名，落後頭馬6.25個馬位。最近10月13日出試沙田草地1000米，早段居中，末段自動加速跑第一名，贏短馬頭位。潛質不俗，預計初出會有良好走勢。

formguide.comments_eng: Australian PPG, a 4-year-old gelding, by Capitalist from Real Surreal, a daughter of Real Saga. Horses by the same sire include Geneva and Superb Capitalist. The fellow was given six trials for one placing in Hong Kong. He sat last and finished third under slight pressure, beaten by 1L, over 800m on turf in Conghua on April 13. In the latest trial, he was taken back and finished tenth under a hold, beaten by 7-1/2Ls, over 1200m on turf in Conghua on October 5. He will probably need a run.
formguide.comments_chi: 「巨富」(Capitalist)之後，在港同父馬包括「增強」及「八駿巨昇」等駒，生母出自「現代傳說」(Real Saga)。抵港後六次試閘一次上名。4月13日出試從化草地800米，早段居包尾位置，末段稍騎下跑第三名，落後頭馬一個馬位。最近10月5日出試從化草地1200米，起步居後，末段按韁下跑第十名，落後頭馬7.5個馬位。首戰熱身為主。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W4W) Jumped awkwardly from the widest barrier and soon dropped to last few, raced keenly behind runners 900M out, shifted wide for a run into straight, found nothing.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W4W) 自大外檔出閘笨拙，瞬即墮居最後數位之內。九百米處在馬匹之後搶口。入直路時移出外疊取位，再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W) Jumped well, raced in 2nd, 2 wide, 1-1/2L back turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened final furlong. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W) 出閘迅速，居第二位，走第二疊。入直路時落後一個半馬位。直路早段未能再增速。最後二百米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Away well, sent forward to take the lead, led by 1/4L turning in, kept on well early in straight, peaked and headed 150M, weakened gradually final 50M, finished 3rd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。入直路時領先四分一個馬位，直路初保持佳勢。一百五十米處未能再增速，被超越。最後五十米逐漸轉弱，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; Shifted out at start, raced prominently on the stands' rail, hard ridden approaching 300M, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;起步時向外斜跑，居前列，走外欄。趨近三百米處時受力策。末段以穩勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Showed good speed to lead, edged right under pressure when challenged 100m out, headed 50m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;展現甚快前速，取得領先。一百米處受挑戰，在催策下內閃。五十米處被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W) Sat handy 2 wide, limited response when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W) 居前列，走第二疊。對催策反應平平。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Chased leader, weakened passing 250M, never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 追趕領放馬。跑過二百五十米處時轉弱。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Bumped out of stalls and lost balance, tracked leaders, ridden along 400m out, weakened final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;出閘時被碰撞，失去平衡，跟隨領先馬匹。四百米處受催策。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Jumped swiftly and cut across to the stands' rail, pressured for the lead throughout the event, run peaked at 200m and weakened gradually.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;出閘迅速，切向外欄。沿途在催策下爭奪領先。二百米處未能再增速，逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; Jumped well, raced prominently on the stands' side, 3/4L back at 400M, took the lead approaching final 100M, kept on well to the line and scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;出閘迅速，居前列，靠近外欄競跑。四百米處落後四分三個馬位。趨近一百米處時取得領先。保持佳勢至終點，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(-) (1W1W) Ridden along to lead, kept on to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(-)(1W1W) 在催策下帶頭。保持走勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W4W) Sat on pace 3 wide, pushed along wide into home straight, made no impression in home straight. (Made respiratory noise.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W4W) 居前列，走第三疊。入直路時受推策，走外疊。直路上毫無表現。（發出呼吸聲）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Raced in touch with leaders, well placed into home straight, flattened out final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹。入直路時居好位。最後二百米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Sat off midfield on the rail, made little impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。無甚表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) Settled midfield, traveled nicely, kept on well to the line and scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)居中間位置，走勢良佳。保持佳勢至終點，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Slightly slow out and made contact, positioned 2 wide in midfield, same position on turn, finished off well to take a place, nearest on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘稍慢，觸碰他駒。居中間位置，走第二疊。直路彎保持相同位置。衝刺良佳，取得季軍，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (3W4W) Out with rest, raced towards rear on the outside, 5 to 6 lengths back turning in, made minor progress in the run home. (See Racing Incidents.)
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(3W4W) 與對手同步出閘，居後列，走外疊。入直路時落後五至六個馬位。末段略為追前。（見競賽事件報告。）
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Held up last, keen 800m out, unable to secure clear run until 200m out, ran on strongly to close on winner late on but always held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 留居包尾位置。八百米處搶口。未能望空直至二百米處。末段以勁勢上前，追近頭馬，但一直落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W4W) Mid-field, tight for room 400m out, stayed on final 300m but no threat to leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W4W) 居中間位置。四百米處空位不足。最後三百米保持走勢，但未能威脅領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) Raced in touch, chased leaders from top of home straight, stuck to task but lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。自直路初起追趕領先馬匹。持續力拼，但速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) Taken back from a wide draw, raced at tail, 5-1/2L back turning in, made minor progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 自外檔出閘後留居包尾位置。入直路時落後五個半馬位。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Jumped with them, positioned 2 lengths behind the leader, nearer to the middle track, hard ridden from 400M but only showed limited response, weakened gradually final 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;與對手同步出閘，落後領放馬兩個馬位，靠近跑道中央競跑。自四百米處起受力策，但反應僅屬平平。最後二百米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) Shuffled back after slowly away, outpaced middle stages, ran on strongly but hung out final 300m to close on winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)出閘緩慢，其後居後列。中段未能跟上步速。最後三百米以勁勢追近頭馬，但外閃。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Sat on pace on the rail, weakened and gave ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 居前列，走內欄。末段轉弱及墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Bumped shortly after start, settled in rear of mid-field, under pressure 500m out, unable to quicken.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;起步後不久與對手互相碰撞，居中間之後位置。五百米處受催策，未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Sat midfield 2 wide, unable to quicken in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。直路上未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; Jumped only fairly, raced slightly behind midfield on the stands' side, inconvenienced near 650M, 3 to 4 lengths back at 400M, kept on one-paced to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;出閘僅屬一般，居中間稍後位置，靠近外欄競跑。接近六百五十米處時受妨礙。四百米處落後三至四個馬位。保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; In rear on outside of field, followed winner through from 300m out, found that rival too strong but stayed on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;居馬群外側的後列位置。自三百米處起跟隨頭馬上前。未能與頭馬抗衡，但保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; Settled in rear of mid-field, short of room final 400m, not fully extended.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;居中間之後位置。最後四百米空位不足。未能全力施為。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Mid-field towards outer, headway alongside winner 300m out, run petered out final 150m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;居中間位置，離外欄競跑。三百米處與頭馬一同追前。最後一百五十米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Raced keenly throughout and had to make a wide forward move from the 700M, ran out abruptly near the 150M, faded and eased down thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 沿途搶口。自七百米處起須自外疊發力上前。接近一百五十米處時急促向外斜跑，力竭，其後收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Shifted out at start and made contact, raced slightly behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, peaked early in straight, weakened and eased thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 起步時向外斜跑及觸碰對手，居中間稍後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初未能再增速，其後轉弱及收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W2W) Taken back to race at rear on the inside, 2 wide turning in, made some progress early in straight, peaked on run 150M, ran on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W2W) 留居後列，走內疊。入直路時走第二疊。直路初略為追前。一百五十米處未能再增速。末段以穩勢上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W1W) Settled rear, raced keenly in the early stages, was held up for clear running until 300M, responded well when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W1W) 居後列，早段搶口。三百米處前受困而未能望空。末段對催策反應良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W4W) Settled worse than midfield 2 wide, never quickened.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W4W) 居中間之後位置，走第二疊。未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Fast; (4W7W) Jumped only fairly, settled down behind midfield 5Ls back, swung wide for home before running on at same pace early straight, eased when no chance.
(Roarer again.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
快步速;(4W7W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置，落後五個馬位。轉直路彎時移出外疊。直路初上前，保持同速。在爭勝無望時收慢。
（再次患有喘鳴症。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Settled in front of midfield 2 wide, ran on fairly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居中間之前位置，走第二疊。末段走勢一般。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Sat behind midfield, closed off fairly, limited response when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 居中間之後位置。末段衝刺一般，對催策反應平平。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Settled midfield, traveled fairly, ran on evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，走勢一般。末段保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Moderately away, raced behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, kept on same pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘普通，居中間之後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W5W) Settled behind midfield 2 wide, only one pace when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W5W) 居中間之後位置，走第二疊。在催策下僅能保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Sat behind the lead on the rail, one pace when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領放馬，走內欄。在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Sat on pace, weakened at the top of the Straight, closed off only fairly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居前列。直路初轉弱。末段衝刺僅屬一般。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Caught 3 wide near midfield, weakened in the Straight. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 居接近中間位置，走第三疊。直路上轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W2W1W) Took up running just before the 1000M bend, obtained rails run over 800M out, led until headed after straightening, folded up quickly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W2W1W) 就在一千米處彎位前取得領先。八百米處移入內欄。保持領先，直至入直路後被超越，迅速力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Pressed in front, unable to hold position by halfway and dropped away quickly, eased when detached 200m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;在領放下受追迫。半程前未能保持位置。其後迅速墮退。二百米處被拋離，收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Made running, headed 200m out, weakened, eased final 50m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 帶頭競跑。二百米處被超越。轉弱，最後五十米收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Began well, sent forward to take the lead, led by a length turning in, kept on well in straight but unable to hold off the winner final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。入直路時領先一個馬位。直路上保持佳勢，但最後一百五十米未能抗衡頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Began well from gate 1, positioned 2 lengths behind the leader on rail, saved ground on turn, showed no response early in straight, weakened final 250M. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，落後領放馬兩個馬位，走內欄。直路彎走內欄節省腳程。直路早段對催策毫無反應，最後二百五十米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) Across to press leader, under pressure 500m out, stayed on well but no match for winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 切入以追迫領放馬。五百米處受催策。保持佳勢，但未能抗衡頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Broke well from the one draw niggling along early, gradually settled about 2L back in 3rd from over 800M out, obtained a clear run over 200M out but unable to quicken to threaten.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，早段受催策。自八百米處起逐漸居第三位，落後約兩個馬位。二百米處望空，但未能加速以構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Began smartly from gate 12, sent forward to take the lead, travelled well to turn, kept on well in straight but unable to hold off the first two final 50M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自第十二檔出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。直路彎前走勢良佳。直路上保持佳勢，但最後五十米未能抗衡頭兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (4W4W) Caught 3 wide near midfield, weakened in the Straight. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(4W4W) 居接近中間位置，走第三疊。直路上轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W) Made running, challenged 300m out, saw off that rival after sustained battle, headed by winner close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W) 帶頭競跑。三百米處受挑戰。持續力拼，力拒對手。接近終點時被頭馬超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W1W) Jumped well from a wide draw, sent forward to take the lead, led by 1/2L turning in, kept on well early in straight, peaked 150M, headed 100M, weakened gradually close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W1W) 自外檔出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。入直路時領先半個馬位。直路初保持佳勢。一百五十米處未能再加速。一百米處被超越。接近終點時逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Raced on outside of field from low draw, good headway from 300m out despite edging left, led 50m out, cosy winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;自第一檔出閘，居馬群外側競跑。自三百米處起儘管外閃，但追前甚多。五十米處取得領先，輕鬆取勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Chased leader, pushed along 400m out, weakened final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;追趕領放馬。四百米處受推策。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Ridden hard to lead, weakened notably inside 300M, failed to respond.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 在力策下取得領先。最後三百米顯著轉弱。對催策毫無反應。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (4W3W) Ridden along from a poor draw to be up with the pace 5-wide, closer to rail 3-wide rounding home bend and shared 2nd into straight, unable to sustain effort inside final 300M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(4W3W) 自外檔出閘，受催策，跟隨領放馬，走第五疊。轉直路彎時移近內欄，走第三疊。入直路時並居第二位。最後三百米無以為繼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Chased leader, tight for room against rail and had to switch 200m out, stayed on at the one pace after.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 追趕領放馬。沿欄受緊迫，二百米處須轉換跑線，其後保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Raced prominently, led briefly 200m out, stuck to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 居前列。二百米處一度領先。持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(+) (3W2W) Jumped awkwardly, chased the leader, kept on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(+)(3W2W) 出閘笨拙，追趕領放馬。保持穩勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(+) (2W3W) Raced in touch, smooth headway into contention 300m out, chased leader from there, on top final 50m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(+)(2W3W) 緊隨領先馬匹。三百米處以暢順走勢上前，躋身爭勝行列。自該處起追趕領放馬。最後五十米取得領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (5W4W) From draw 11 positioned close to the pace but caught wide no cover throughout, kept on soundly in the straight to finish a respectable 3rd despite the tough journey.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(5W4W) 自第十一檔出閘，緊隨領放馬，但沿途走外疊，沒有遮擋。儘管際遇欠佳，但直路上仍保持不俗走勢，取得季軍，表現可嘉。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W3W) Sat behind midfield 2 wide, stayed on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W3W) 居中間之後位置，走第二疊。末段保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W3W) Settled in 4th about 2L off the pace, commenced move between runners entering home straight but unable to quicken under pressure throughout.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W3W) 居第四位，落後領放馬約兩個馬位。入直路時在馬匹之間開始發力，但沿途在催策下未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W3W) Mid-field, headway onto heels of leaders bend, one paced under pressure from 300m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W3W) 居中間位置。直路彎上前緊隨領先馬匹。自三百米處起在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Settled in midfield near the rail, saved ground turning in for home, improved under pressure to reach distant 2nd over 150M out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，靠近內欄競跑。轉入直路時走內欄節省腳程，在催策下上前，一百五十米處進佔第二位，落後頗遠。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Settled worse than midfield on the rail, ran on strongly for 3rd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。走勢強勁，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Ridden along to lead, traveled strongly, responded nicely when asked, just missed (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 在催策下領放。走勢強勁。末段對催策反應良佳。僅敗。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Sat in front of midfield 2 wide, never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居中間之前位置，走第二疊。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Jumped well from the widest draw, raced better than midfield on outer, no cover throughout, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 自大外檔出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走外疊。沿途沒有遮擋。直路早段未能再增速，其後轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (4W3W1W) Dropped out from widest draw, held up last, detached from 500m out, never involved.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(4W3W1W) 自大外檔出閘後墮後，留居包尾位置。自五百米處起被拋離。從未參與競逐。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W2W) Sat last, never involved.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W2W) 居包尾位置。從未參與競逐。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Rail position in mid-field, struggled to hold position final bend, outpaced and left behind final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。直路彎難以保持位置。最後二百米未能跟上步速，被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Slow; (1W1W) From draw 1 moved up to track leader, pulled hard during the race, failed to finish the job when asked early in the straight.
Jockey dropped whip 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
慢步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘，上前跟隨領放馬。陣上大力搶口。直路初受催策，但未能以勁勢衝刺。
騎師於一百五十米處跌掉馬鞭。
runnerrecords.incident_chi: 騎師於一百五十米處跌掉馬鞭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Mid-field, had to wait for run in first half of home straight, ran on well once gaps appeared final 150m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 居中間位置。直路前半段須等待空位出現。最後一百五十米望空後隨即以佳勢上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W3W) Sat in front of midfield on the rail, made no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W3W) 居中間之前位置，走內欄。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W) Gradually shifted back early to rear of midfield very wide without cover, ridden slightly closer for 3-wide position with cover home bend, kept on under pressure from over 3L 5th into straight until faded inside final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W) 早段逐漸留居中間之後位置，走大外疊，沒有遮擋。直路彎受催策，略為追近，走第三疊，有遮擋。入直路時居第五位，落後逾三個馬位，在催策下保持走勢，直至最後一百米力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Bumped on jumping, raced better than midfield on the outside, 3 lengths or so back turning in, peaked early in straight, kept on same pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 躍出時發生碰撞，居中間之前位置，走外疊。入直路時落後約三個馬位。直路早段未能再增速。保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Made running, ran on strongly to go clear final 200m despite hanging left, very comprehensive winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 帶頭競跑。儘管外閃，但走勢強勁，最後二百米帶離對手。以壓倒性的優勢勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Jumped well, sent forward to take the lead, led by 1/2L turning in, challenged by rival early in straight, peaked and headed approaching 200M, weakened final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。入直路時領先半個馬位。直路早段受對手挑戰。趨近二百米處時未能再增速及被超越。最後一百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W1W) Sent forward and lead, kept on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W1W) 受催策上前領放。末段保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (3W4W) Shifted out at start and bumped, raced slightly behind midfield on the outside, 4 lengths or so back turning in, made very good progress in straight, just beaten in a ding-dong battle.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(3W4W) 起步時向外斜跑及被碰撞，居中間稍後位置，走外疊。入直路時落後約四個馬位。直路上追前甚多。末段在叮噹馬頭下僅敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; Tracked leaders, under pressure halfway out, stayed on but lacked pace to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;跟隨領先馬匹。半程時受催策。末段保持走勢，但未能加速以追及領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Not the best away, recovered to race mid-field, keen, under pressure 400m out, limited response, one paced.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 出閘並非最快。恢復走勢，居中間位置，搶口。四百米處受催策，反應平平。保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Began awkwardly and made contact, raced prominently on the outside, travelled keenly in the early stages, 1-3/4L back turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened gradually inside final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 出閘笨拙，與對手互相觸碰，居前列，走外疊。早段搶口。入直路時落後一又四分三個馬位。直路早段未能再增速。最後二百米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Rear of mid-field, tended to hang left, including when pushed along over 300m out, held when eased final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 居中間之後位置，傾向外閃，包括於三百米處受推策時。最後二百米收慢時落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W4W) Sat 3 wide on pace, kept on without threatening
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W4W) 跟隨領放馬，走第三疊。保持走勢，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Made contact shortly after start, raced at rear, 5 lengths back in the middle stages, made no impression final 400M. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;起步後不久與對手互相觸碰，居後列。中段落後五個馬位。最後四百米毫無表現。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; Jumped awkwardly and lost ground, raced towards rear on the stands' side, short of room final 400M, not able to test properly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;出閘笨拙及失地，居後列，走外欄。最後四百米空位不足。未能全力施為。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(+) (1W2W) Never far off, travelled keenly in 3rd behind leader on rail, angled out for a run into home straight, ran on to hold every chance only to be outsprinted inside final 50M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(+)(1W2W) 從未遠離領放馬，居領放馬之後的第三位，走內欄，搶口。入直路時向外移出取位。末段追前，一度甚具爭勝機會，僅於最後五十米告不敵。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W3W) Sat in front of midfield 2 wide, one pace when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W3W) 居中間之前位置，走第二疊。末段在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) From a wide draw taken back to near the rear, no daylight until 250M, ran on strongly just missed by a short head.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 自外檔出閘，留居後列。末能望空直至二百五十米處。以勁勢上前，僅以短馬頭位落敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (5W5W) Very wide throughout from high draw, lost ground on leaders on bend, headway 200m out, flattened out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(5W5W) 自最外檔出閘，沿途走大外疊。直路彎落後領先馬匹。二百米處追前，洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W4W) Settled midfield, traveled reasonably well, dropped back quickly in the Straight (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W4W) 居中間位置。走勢不俗。直路上迅速墮退。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Settled midfield 3 wide without cover, hard ridden at the top of the straight but found little and was one-paced to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 居中間位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。直路初受力策，但再無餘力，保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Settled some 3L off the pace in 5th on rail, kept on under pressure after straightening before finding no extra closing stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居第五位，落後領放馬約三個馬位，走內欄。入直路後在催策下保持走勢。末段再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W4W) Settled midfield, switched out rounding the Turn, responded nicely when asked (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W4W) 居中間位置。轉直路彎時向外移出。對催策反應良佳。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W1W1W) Began only fairly, raced at rear on the inside, 6 lengths or so back turning in, made some headway in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，居後列，走內疊。入直路時落後約六個馬位。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Rail position in rear of mid-field, under pressure to hold position 600m out, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。六百米處受催策以保持位置。速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W3W) Sluggish start, pushed up to race in rear of mid-field, stayed on for pressure final 300m, in contention and every chance final 150m, bumped by rival late on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W3W) 出閘緩慢，受推策上前，居中間之後位置。最後三百米在催策下保持走勢。最後一百五十米持續拼鬥，一度甚具爭勝機會。末段被對手碰撞。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W4W) Moderately away, raced towards rear on the outside, 6 lengths back turning in, made no impression in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W4W) 出閘普通，居後列，走外疊。入直路時落後六個馬位。直路上毫無表現。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Crowded start, raced at tail, saved ground on turn, kept to inside after straightening and made some progress.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 起步時受擠迫，居包尾位置。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。入直路後保持走內疊，略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (4W2W2W1W) Soon taken well back from a poor draw, remained in last few before sneaking closer on rail turning in for home, ran on steadily under pressure without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(4W2W2W1W) 自外檔出閘後瞬即留居遙遙落後的位置。轉直路彎時仍居最後數位之內，入直路時沿欄追近。在催策下保持穩勢，未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; Commenced well, taken back to race behind midfield on the stands' side, passed some tired runners final 400M. (See Racing Incidents.)
Lost left front plate.
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;出閘迅速。留居中間之後位置，靠近外欄競跑。最後四百米超越數匹已呈疲態的對手。（見競賽事件報告。）
失去左前蹄的蹄鐵。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W2W) Sat handy 2 wide, never a threat. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W2W) 居前列，走第二疊。從未能構成威脅。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W1W1W) Sat behind midfield, traveled greenly, minor ground made.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W1W1W) 居中間之後位置。走勢稚嫩。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W1W1W) Sat rear, held up between the 200M to 150M, minor progress made in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W1W1W) 居後列。二百米處至一百五十米處之間受困。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W4W) Sat off midfield 3 wide, never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W4W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W2W) Settled in front of midfield, held up until the 200M, closed off okay. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W2W) 居中間之前位置。受困直至二百米處。末段衝刺尚可。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W4W) Prominent very wide after beginning from a poor draw, remained 3-wide without cover in 5th over 2L back to home straight, ran on to hold every chance until the 200M when found no extra.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W4W) 自外檔出閘，居前列，走大外疊。直路前保持居第五位，落後逾兩個馬位，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。上前，一度極具爭勝機會直至二百米處，其後再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W3W) Rail position in mid-field, angled out to make run 700m out, stayed on well in home straight for clear third.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W3W) 居中間位置，走內欄。七百米處向外移出取位。直路上保持佳勢，在帶離餘駒下取得季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W1W1W3W) Prominent and wide early from the widest draw of the small field, eventually settled in 4th onto first bend, over 6L off the speed in back straight and unable to make any impression in the critical stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W1W1W3W) 自最外檔出閘，早段在六駒中居前列，走外疊。開始轉首個彎位時居第四位。對面直路上落後領放馬逾六個馬位，末段毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(-) (3W3W) Jumped awkwardly, chased leaders in a 3-wide spot without cover, couldn't go with first two passing 300M, battled on late stages to hold 3rd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(-)(3W3W) 出閘笨拙，追趕領先馬匹，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。跑過三百米處時未能跟隨頭兩名馬匹上前。末段在力拼下保住季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W3W) Broke well from a poor draw, settled one off the lead and gradually shifted across for 3-wide position over 1100M out, came to challenge upon straightening and gained upper hand 50M out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W3W) 自外檔出閘迅速，落後領放馬一個馬位。千一米處逐漸切入第三疊。入直路時展開挑戰。五十米處佔得上風。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W1W1W1W) Ended up leading, set very slow pace in early and middle stages, quickened up tempo 600M, couldn't hold off winner 300M, kept on to hold 2nd comfortably.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W1W1W1W) 取得領先，早段及中段以非常緩慢步速領放。六百米處加快步速，三百米處未能抗衡頭馬。末段保持走勢，穩奪亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W3W) Niggled at early, 3-wide in 6th some 2L back before making headway inside the 1200M, reached within 1L of pace 3-wide onto first bend, hampered and lost position 900M out, soon weakened in straight. (See Incidents Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W3W) 早段受催策，居第六位，落後約兩個馬位，走第三疊。千二米處上前，開始轉首個彎位時追近至落後領放馬不逾一個馬位，走第三疊。九百米處受阻礙及失位，直路上瞬即轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (1W3W) Settled in last few from a poor draw and waited with, shifted off rail for a run entering home straight, quickened well inside final 300M to hit the front 150M out, hung on well under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(1W3W) 自外檔出閘，居最後數位之內，留力候上。入直路時移離內欄取位。最後三百米以佳勢加速。一百五十米處取得領先。在催策下保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(-) (1W2W) Shifted out and bumped out of stalls, rail position in rear of mid-field, driven 350m out, strong run to challenge winner, just failed.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(-)(1W2W) 出閘時向外斜跑及與對手互相碰撞，居中間之後位置，走內欄。三百五十米處受催策。以勁勢上前挑戰頭馬，僅敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W1W3W) Settled at the back of the small field travelling some 10L off the speed, ran on to reach remote 3rd briefly about 100M out but headed for the placing late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W1W3W) 在六駒中居後列，落後領放馬約十個馬位。末段上前，約一百米處一度進佔落後頗遠的第三位，但末段被超越，失去位置。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(-) (2W3W) Chased leader early, drifted back after being steadied 800M, had difficulty obtaining clear running 350-250M before running on mildly to the line to share 4th spot.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(-)(2W3W) 早段追趕領放馬。八百米處收慢後墮退。三百五十米處至二百五十米處之間難以望空。末段走勢普通，取得平頭第四名。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W5W) Settled in forward of midfield, drifted slightly backward to rear of midfield when pace quickened onto home bend, shifted wide for a run but slightly inconvenienced upon straightening, fought on steadily without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W5W) 居中間之前位置。開始轉直路彎賽事步速加快時略為墮居中間之後位置。入直路時移出外疊取位，但略受妨礙。持續力拼，未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W3W) Jumped fairly, gradually improved to within 2L of pace in joint 3rd 2-wide, hit the front over 200M out only to be swamped inside final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W3W) 出閘一般。逐漸上前，並居第三位，落後領放馬不逾兩個馬位，走第二疊。二百米處取得領先，僅於最後一百米被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W2W) Pressed forward from a wide draw, unable to go near the rail before joining race leader 2-wide 900M out approaching first turn, hit the front 200M out to win readily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W2W) 自外檔出閘後受催策上前，未能移近內欄。九百米處趨近首個彎位時追上領放馬，走第二疊。二百米處取得領先，從容獲勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Settled towards the rear, 5Ls to make up passing 400M but lacked a kick in the straight. (Jockey satisfied with the finishing effort in the straight / No Vet findings.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居後列。跑過四百米處時落後五個馬位，但直路上未能加速。（騎師滿意坐騎在直路上的衝刺。賽後接受獸醫檢查，並無發現任何明顯異常之處。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Out in line, taken back to race at rear on the outside, 4-1/2L back turning in, made no impression in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 與對手同步出閘，留居後列，走外疊。轉入直路時落後四個半馬位。直路上毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Settled in rear over 7L off the pace, baulked until inside the 200M out, quickened well to reach distant 2nd 60M out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 居後列，落後領放馬逾七個馬位。受困直至二百米處。末段加速良佳，六十米處進佔落後頗遠的第二位。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W) Jumped well and reserved in midfield, battled on well to take 2nd near 150M but once again proved no match for champion KA YING RISING.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W) 出閘迅速，留居中間位置。以佳勢力拼，接近一百五十米處時進佔第二位，但再次不敵香港馬王「嘉應高昇」。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Sat midfield on the rail, closed off nicely, just no threat to winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 居中間位置，走內欄。末段衝刺良佳，但未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W6W) Made contact at start, raced 2 wide in midfield, 3 wide approaching 600M, carried wider turning in, kept on evenly in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W6W) 起步時發生觸碰，居中間位置，走第二疊。趨近六百米處時走第三疊。入直路時被帶出更外疊。直路上保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Sat behind midfield 2 wide, no clear run in the early straight, made good ground in the final furlong, closed off nicely.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居中間之後位置，走第二疊。直路初未能望空。最後二百米追前甚多，末段以佳勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Jumped on terms and settled down in midfield along the fence, quickened up well after moving into the clear 400M, led near 100M and gamely prevailed from the fast finishing runner-up late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間位置，走內欄。四百米處望空，其後加速良佳。接近一百米處時領先。末段險勝衝刺甚快的亞軍馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (2W3W) Settled towards rear in 11th and waited with, baulked for a run after straightening until inside the 300M, finished off the race well under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(2W3W) 居後列第十一位，留力候上。入直路後受困直至三百米處。在催策下於末段以勁勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (2W2W2W3W) Settled in midfield, commenced move upon straightening and responded well to take charge over 150M out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(2W2W2W3W) 居中間位置。入直路時開始上前。對催策反應良佳，一百五十米處取得領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (1W1W) Rail position in mid-field, had to wait for run turning into home straight, challenged up rail from 250m out, ran on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。轉入直路時須等待空位出現。自二百五十米處起沿欄展開挑戰。末段以佳勢上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W5W) Given a waiting ride at the rear of the field, brought wide 550M, ran on without serious threat. (Jockey reminded to ride out to the finish of the race.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W5W) 居後列，留力候上。五百五十米處被帶出外疊。未能構成真正威脅。（小組提醒騎師有責任確保全力催策坐騎至終點。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (2W4W) Out with rest, raced 2 wide behind midfield, angled out after passing 600M, very wide turning in, finished off very strongly to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(2W4W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。跑過六百米處後向外移出。入直路時走大外疊。衝刺凌厲，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(-) (1W1W) Rail position in mid-field, quickened between horses to lead 150m out and soon on top, won readily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(-)(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。在馬群之中加速上前，一百五十米處取得領先，瞬即帶離對手。從容勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Settled down in mid-division 6Ls off leader, travelled well turning for home, had to shift to outside for clear running mid-straight before getting home strongly to lead near line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，落後領放馬六個馬位。轉直路彎時走勢良佳。直路中段須移出外疊以望空。末段衝刺強勁，接近終點時取得領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(-) (1W2W) Rail position in mid-field, keen 750m out, under pressure 500m out, ran on strongly to lead 150m out, on top from there.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(-)(1W2W) 居中間位置，走內欄。七百五十米處搶口。五百米處受催策。走勢強勁，一百五十米處取得領先。其後保持領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (1W1W) Taken well back from the widest barrier and waited with, commenced move on rail home bend saving ground for 2.5L 7th into straight, obtained clear run back on rail 200M out, ran on dourly under pressure to just fail.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(1W1W) 自大外檔出閘後遙居後列，留力候上。直路彎開始發力，走內欄以省腳程。入直路時居第七位，落後兩個半馬位。二百米處移回內欄望空。在催策下持續力拼，僅敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W5W) Not hurried and settled near last in early and middle stages, brought wide for home before staying on well to take 5th on testing ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W5W) 早段及中段未受催策，居接近包尾位置。入直路時移出外疊。其後保持佳勢，跑軟地取得第五名。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W3W) Tracked pace out wide without cover, struggled to hold position from 500m out, gave ground final 300m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W3W) 跟隨領放馬，走外疊，沒有遮擋。自五百米處起難以保持位置。最後三百米墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W1W1W) Soon took up running setting a sound pace and attempting to make all, led until finding no extra inside final 300M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W1W1W) 瞬即帶頭，以快步速領放，試圖一放到底。保持領先，直至最後三百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W4W) Given a waiting ride at the rear, commenced his move 550M, came closest to leaders 250M but had nothing more to offer final stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W4W) 居包尾位置，留力候上。五百五十米處開始上前。二百五十米處最接近領先馬匹，但末段再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Taken back from a wide draw and raced near last, 5Ls off leader home turn, worked home steadily from 400M but was never a serious threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 自最外檔出閘，留居接近包尾位置。直路彎落後領放馬五個馬位。自四百米處起衝刺平穩，但從未能構成真正威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W) Soon recovered along the rail from a slow start, over 2L back in 5th before gaining slightly closer to pace into home straight, tightened when beaten inside the 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W) 起步緩慢，瞬即恢復走勢，居第五位，落後逾兩個馬位，走內欄。入直路時略為追近領放馬。二百米處在受緊迫之際洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W3W) Sluggish start, raced in touch with leaders, taken wider 700m out, bumped 250m out, unable to recover.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W3W) 出閘緩慢，緊隨領先馬匹。七百米處移出較外疊。二百五十米處被碰撞，未能恢復走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Taken back from a wide draw, raced 2 wide at rear, found rail 700M, 4 to 5 lengths back turning in, made some headway in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 自外檔出閘後留後，居後列，走第二疊。七百米處移入內欄。入直路時落後四至五個馬位。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W2W) In midfield early before moving closer to leaders from 1000M, caught racing wide no cover to the straight, run ended 300M and dropped out from contention.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W2W) 早段居中間位置。自一千米處起追近領先馬匹。直路前走外疊，沒有遮擋。三百米處無以為繼。其後墮退，再無爭勝機會。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Settled midfield, traveled nicely, made good ground when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 居中間位置，走勢良佳。在催策下追前甚多。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (1W4W) Jumped fairly from draw 11, taken back to last 7-8Ls off the pace middle stages, wide into straight before closing off nicely to take 3rd. Nearest finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(1W4W) 自第十一檔出閘僅屬一般，中段留居包尾位置，落後領放馬七至八個馬位。入直路時走外疊，末段衝刺良佳，跑獲季軍。過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(-) (2W3W) Settled in mid-field, had to wait for run turning into home straight, ridden along 300m out, ran on well to close on winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(-)(2W3W) 居中間位置。轉入直路時須等待空位出現。三百米處受催策。以佳勢上前，追近頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Ridden to muster early pace before settling some 2L back in 3rd or 4th on rail, further off the pace when tempo increased home bend, commenced move into straight, ran on under pressure to just prevail inside the 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 早段在催策下加速，其後居第三或第四位，落後約兩個馬位，走內欄。直路彎步速加快時落後領放馬更遠。入直路時開始發力。最後一百五十米在催策下上前，僅勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W2W) Held up last, still in last pair top of home straight, short of room final 100m, unable to be ridden out to finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W2W) 留居包尾位置。直路初仍居最後兩位之內。最後一百米空位不足，未能被力策至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W3W) Began only fairly and bumped, raced 2 wide at rear, there to turn, made good progress in straight to make frame, no threat to the first few.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W3W) 出閘僅屬一般及被碰撞，居後列，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路上追前甚多，取得第四名，但未能威脅三甲馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W5W) Jumped only fairly, raced at tail, 5 to 6 lengths back turning in, passed some tired runners in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W5W) 出閘僅屬一般，居包尾位置。入直路時落後五至六個馬位。直路上超越一些已呈疲態的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Sat rear, switched out rounding the Turn, made steady progress late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 居後列。轉直路彎時向外移出。末段穩步上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W5W) Slightly slow away, settled near last, switched widest 600M before closing off fairly in the straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W5W) 出閘稍慢，居後列。六百米處移出最外疊。直路上衝刺一般。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Restrained in mid-division, had about 4Ls to make up 400M, made up good ground in the run home and ran the winner close late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 受約束居中間位置，四百米處落後約四個馬位。末段追前頗多，緊隨頭馬衝線。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Fast; (1W1W) Slow to begin, recovered to race behind midfield, came under pressure home turn, couldn't go on passing 250M and soon left behind by leaders.
(Bled.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
快步速;(1W1W) 出閘緩慢，其後恢復走勢，居中間之後位置。直路彎受催策。跑過二百五十米處時未能追前，瞬即被領先馬匹拋離。
（流鼻血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (2W2W2W3W) Settled well behind and waited with, obtained a clear run upon straightening 400M out, finished off the race strongly down the centre of track.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(2W2W2W3W) 遙居於後，留力候上。四百米處入直路時望空。在跑道中央以勁勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (2W5W) Dropped out from wide draw, pushed along wide into home straight, strong run to lead 150m out, on top from there.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(2W5W) 自外檔出閘後墮後。入直路時受推策，走外疊。走勢強勁，一百五十米處取得領先。其後保持領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (3W5W) Taken back from the widest draw, raced at tail, 6 to 7 lengths back turning in, very wide into straight, finished off very strongly to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(3W5W) 自最外檔出閘後留居包尾位置。入直路時落後六至七個馬位，走大外疊。末段衝刺凌厲，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W5W) Raced in touch with leaders out wide, tended to hang out on bend, pushed ahead over 200m out, weakened final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W5W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走外疊。直路彎傾向外閃。二百米處受推策上前。最後一百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(-) (1W3W) Rail position in mid-field, did not travel with much fluency on bend, unable to secure clear run until 300m out, ran on strongly final 200m, just failed.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(-)(1W3W) 居中間位置，走內欄。直路彎走勢欠順。未能望空直至三百米處。最後二百米以勁勢上前，僅敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Went forward to be chasing leader 2-wide, vied for lead from 300M but couldn't contain the pursuing rivals final stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 上前追趕領放馬，走第二疊。自三百米處起爭奪領先，但末段未能抗衡後上的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W2W) Pressed forward from wide draw without cover 1200M out to join the leader onto home bend, some 1L back 2-wide into the straight, weakened under pressure inside final 300M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W2W) 自大外檔出閘後受催策上前。千二米處沒有遮擋。開始轉直路彎時追上領放馬。入直路時落後約一個馬位，走第二疊。最後三百米在催策下轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Soon led setting steady pace in front under 10lb claimer, headed 350M but refused to give in, fought bravely to the line for a respectable 4th .
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 由獲讓十磅的見習騎師策騎，瞬即取得領先，以平穩步速領放。三百五十米處被超越，但奮力頑抗，力拼至終點，取得第四名，表現不俗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Soon led under 10lb claimer, set slow pace early stages before quickening up halfway, was strongly pressed by eventual 2nd final 250M but held on bravely.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 由獲讓十磅的見習騎師策騎，瞬即領放。早段以慢步速領放。半程時加速。最後二百五十米受亞軍馬匹以勁勢追迫，但力保勝果。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W1W1W) In front early stages but was restrained to race behind leader on settling, couldn't find extra gear to challenge passing 350M, faded final stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 早段居前列，其後受約束以跟隨領放馬。跑過三百五十米處時未能加速以展開挑戰，末段力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W1W1W1W) Showed good speed to lead, pressed in front from 500m out, stayed on well in home straight but no match for winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W1W1W1W) 展現甚快前速，取得領先。自五百米處起在領放下受追迫。直路上保持佳勢，但未能抗衡頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W) Led early stages, narrowly headed 2-wide 800M out, faded further out of contention inside final 300M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W) 早段領放。八百米處被超越，落後短距離，走第二疊。最後三百米力竭，進一步墮退，再無爭勝機會。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Waited with towards rear, pushed along wide into home straight, ran on strongly final 300m, edged ahead close home in tight finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 居後列，留力候上。入直路時受推策，走外疊。最後三百米以勁勢追前。接近終點時取得領先，僅勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (2W5W) Towards rear in 7th after beginning from a wide barrier about 6L off the pace, went widest turning for home, ran on well inside final 300M and did best work late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(2W5W) 自外檔出閘，留居後列第七位，落後領放馬約六個馬位。轉入直路時走最外疊。最後三百米以佳勢上前。末段表現最佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W3W) Obtained running in midfield, picked up well on testing conditions from 400M, led passing 150M and won going away.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W3W) 居中間位置。在軟地上自四百米處起加速良佳。跑過一百五十米處時取得領先，帶離對手勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W4W) Bumped and lost balance shortly after start, waited with towards rear, keen 900m out, strong run to lead 100m out, cozy winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W4W) 起步後不久發生碰撞及失去平衡，居後列，留力候上。九百米處搶口。走勢強勁，一百米處取得領先，輕鬆勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (2W4W) Shifted in at start, raced 2 wide behind midfield, commenced move 550M, very wide into straight, showed very good response in straight, hit the front 150M, kept on strongly, easily scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(2W4W) 起步時向內斜跑，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。五百五十米處開始上前，入直路時走大外疊。直路上對催策反應甚佳，一百五十米處取得領先，保持勁勢，輕鬆掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Slow(-) (3W4W) Away with them, raced behind midfield on the outside, commenced move after passing 500M, finished off very strongly to be nearest on line.
(Jockey dropped right rein over the concluding stages.)
runnerrecords.incident_eng: (Jockey dropped right rein over the concluding stages.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
慢步速(-)(3W4W) 與對手同步出閘，居中間之後位置，走外疊。跑過五百米處後開始上前。衝刺凌厲，過終點時最為接近。
（於末段騎師右邊韁繩脫手。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W5W) Sat rear, switched out making the Turn, showed some dash inside 150M, closed off nicely.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W5W) 居後列。轉直路彎時向外移出。一百五十米處略為加速。衝刺良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W2W3W) Chased the pace along the 2-path, wound up strongly to join leader at the 100m but couldn't hold off winner final stages. Game in defeat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W2W3W) 追趕領放馬，走第二疊。其後展開強勁衝刺，一百米處追上領放馬，但末段未能抗衡頭馬，在力拼下僅敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Chased the pace along the inside, loomed behind leaders early straight, improved into a narrow run mid-straight but was badly checked nearing 100M and lost his chance.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 追趕領放馬，走內疊。直路初居領先馬匹之後位置。直路中段推進至窄位，但接近一百米處時大力勒避，失去爭逐機會。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Began awkwardly, sat in 3rd 4-5Ls off leader middle stages, tried hard on straightening but couldn't muster the pace to challenge first two.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘笨拙。中段居第三位，落後領放馬四至五個馬位。入直路時力拼，但未能加速以挑戰頭兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W2W1W2W) Settled just off the pace in 3rd on rail, some 3L off the pace in back straight and further off speed rounding home bend, commenced move into straight but unable to quicken under pressure, dropped away quickly inside final 300M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W2W1W2W) 居領放馬稍後的第三位，走內欄。對面直路上落後領放馬約三個馬位。轉直路彎時落後領放馬更遠。入直路時開始上前，但在催策下未能增速。最後三百米迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Very fast; (2W2W) Settled in mid-field, keen early, checked 200m out, lost all chance and allowed to coast home.
(Roarer again.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
極快步速;(2W2W) 居中間位置，早段搶口。二百米處勒避。其後再無爭逐機會，獲許順其自然地競跑至終點。
（再次患有喘鳴症。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W4W) From draw 13 slotted into a 3-wide spot in mid-division, kept on steadily to be challenging for the lead mid-straight, peaked on its run 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W4W) 自第十三檔出閘，居中間位置，走第三疊。保持穩勢，直路中段爭奪領先。一百米處未能再增速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Settled within 3L of pace mainly in 4th, commenced move on top of home bend 650M out, gained upper hand under pressure 200M out, won cozily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 大多居第四位，落後領放馬不逾三個馬位。直路彎早段六百五十米處開始上前。二百米處在催策下取得領先，從容獲勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W1W2W) Given a waiting ride 8L towards the rear of the field, pressed along 550M, stayed on mildly in the run home for 5th without threatening first three.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W1W2W) 居後列，留力候上，落後八個馬位。五百五十米處受催策。末段保持一般走勢，取得第五名，未能威脅頭三名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W2W4W) Sat at the rear, stayed on nicely until 200M, one pace thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W2W4W) 居後列。保持佳勢直至二百米處，其後保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W4W) Driven along and outpaced early stages, pushed along widest into home straight, ran on well early in home straight, no extra final 50m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W4W) 早段受催策，未能跟上步速。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。直路初以佳勢上前。最後五十米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W1W3W) Soon dropped to the rear in 5th, came under pressure after turning in for home, fought on dourly to claim 3rd 100M out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W1W3W) 瞬即墮退至後列第五位。轉入直路後受催策。持續力拼，一百米處進佔季席。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W1W) Jumped well, sat in front of midfield, lay in near the 200M, (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 出閘迅速，居中間之前位置。接近二百米處時內閃。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W4W3W4W) Taken well back, made rapid progress around the field from 1100M out reaching 3rd one back about 800M out, remained 3-wide without cover bend, kept on under pressure in straight and swamped for a placing inside final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W4W3W4W) 遙居於後。自千一米處起繞過馬群快速上前，八百米處進佔第三位，落後一個馬位。直路彎走第三疊，沒有遮擋。直路上在催策下保持走勢。最後一百米被超越，失去一席位置。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (1W1W1W3W) Sat rear, improved from 650M, had every chance.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(1W1W1W3W) 居包尾位置。自六百五十米處起推進上前。已獲機會盡展所長。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) Made contact shortly after start, positioned 2 wide, a length or so back, there to turn, hit the front 300M, kept on very well to the line, easily scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 起步後不久發生觸碰，落後約一個馬位，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。三百米處取得領先，保持甚佳走勢至終點，從容勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Sat box seat, angled out in the Straight, closed off strongly to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居包廂位置。直路上向外移出。以勁勢衝刺，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Bumped shortly after start, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, made some progress early in straight, no clear run 250M to 50M, ran on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 起步後不久被碰撞，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初略為追前。二百五十米處至五十米處之間未能望空。末段走勢平穩。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Checked early after sluggish start, recovered to race in mid-field, short of room between horses early in home straight and had to switch, burst through to lead 75m out and soon on top, won readily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘緩慢，早段勒避，其後恢復走勢，居中間位置。直路初在馬匹之間空位不足，須轉換跑線。突圍而出，七十五米處取得領先。瞬即帶離對手，從容勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Fast; (4W2W) Driven along from stalls to press leader, dropped away quickly in home straight, eased off.
(Bled.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
快步速;(4W2W) 出閘後受催策，追迫領放馬。直路上迅速墮退，收慢。
（流鼻血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Across to press leader, ridden top of home straight to chase leader, unable to match front three but stayed on for clear fourth.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 切入以追迫領放馬。直路初受催策，追趕領放馬。未能抗衡三甲馬匹，但保持走勢，帶離餘駒，取得第四名。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W) Began well from a wide draw, sent forward to take the lead, led by 1-1/2L turning in, kept on very well in straight and scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W) 自外檔出閘迅速，受催策上前，取得領先。入直路時領先一個半馬位。直路上保持甚佳走勢，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W) Jumped well, raced in 2nd, a length or so back, there to turn, hit the front 250M, kept on very well to the line, easily scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W) 出閘迅速，居第二位，落後約一個馬位。直路彎前居相同位置。二百五十米處取得領先。保持甚佳走勢至終點，輕鬆勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W) Bumped shortly after start, sent forward to take the lead, led by 3/4L turning in, kept on well in straight but unable to hold off the first two final 50M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W) 起步後不久被碰撞，受催策上前領放。入直路時領先四分三個馬位。直路上保持佳勢，但最後五十米未能抗衡首兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Broke well from wide draw, across to make running, quickened over 300m out, in control final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自外檔出閘迅速，切入內欄領放。三百米處加速。最後二百米控制大局。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Average to begin, raced prominently in the middle of the track, hard ridden from 300M but only showed limited response, ran on evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;出閘普通，居前列，在跑道中央競跑。自三百米處起受力策，但反應平平。末段保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (6W1W1W) Dropped out from wide draw, had to wait for run turning into home straight, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(6W1W1W) 自外檔出閘後墮後。轉入直路時須等待空位出現。速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W3W) Caught racing wide behind leaders and had no cover in the middle stages, driven to challenge for the lead 400M, began to weaken 150M, checked 100M losing momentum. (No Vet findings.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W3W) 居領先馬匹之後，走外疊。中段沒有遮擋。四百米處在催策下爭奪領先。一百五十米處開始轉弱。一百米處勒避，失去步韻。（賽後接受獸醫檢查，並無發現任何明顯異常之處。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (1W2W) Rail position in rear of mid-field, angled out to make run 500m out, strong run to lead 100m out, won comfortably.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(1W2W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。五百米處向外移出取位。衝刺強勁，一百米處取得領先，輕鬆勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (5W3W3W) Dropped out from wide draw, pushed along widest into home straight, ran on strongly to make up a lot of ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(5W3W3W) 自外檔出閘後墮後。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。以勁勢上前，追前甚多。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Chased leaders on jumping from draw 1, gave good response turning home, stormed to the lead nearing 100M winning decisively.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 自第一檔出閘，追趕領先馬匹。轉直路彎時對催策反應良佳。接近一百米處時以勁勢取得領先，以漂亮姿態勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W) Sat handy 2 wide, closed off nicely.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W) 居前列，走第二疊。末段衝刺良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (3W2W2W) Settled midfield 2 wide, angled out rounding the Home Turn, closed off strongly to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(3W2W2W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。轉直路彎時向外移出。末段衝刺強勁，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W) Raced in rear of mid-field, dropped to rear 700m out and struggled to hold position, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W) 居中間之後位置。七百米處墮退至後列，難以保持位置。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W4W) Bumped shortly after start, taken back to race at rear on the outside, 4 to 5 lengths back turning in, finished off well to make frame without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W4W) 起步後不久被碰撞，留居後列，走外疊。入直路時落後四至五個馬位。衝刺良佳，取得第四名，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Bumped out of stalls, held up last, still in last place top of home straight, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 出閘時發生碰撞，留居包尾位置。直路初仍居包尾位置。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Rail position in rear of mid-field, angled out 300m out, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。三百米處向外移出，速度不足以展開挑戰。

formguide.comments_eng: New Zealand PP, a 5-year-old gelding, by Super Seth from Sound Of Music, a daughter of O'Reilly. Horses by the same sire include Patch Of Cosmo and Team Team Folks. This fellow had ten starts for three wins (a maiden over 1600m, a handicap over 1600m and a handicap over 1800m) and two placings in Australia. He was given two trials for one win and one placing in Hong Kong. He shared the lead and finished third under slight pressure, beaten by 3-3/4Ls, over 1000m on turf in Conghua on September 21. In the latest trial, he made all to win by 1/2L under slight pressure, over 1200m on turf in Conghua on October 5. He looks like a player here at the first time of asking.
formguide.comments_chi: 「超凡高手」(Super Seth)之後，在港同父馬包括「錶之宇宙」及「天天友福」等駒，生母出自O'Reilly。來港前在澳洲十戰得三勝兩位，頭馬包括一場1600米從未勝出馬賽、一場1600米讓磅賽及一場1800米讓磅賽。抵港後兩次試閘得一勝一位。9月21日出試從化草地1000米，早段並頭領放，末段稍騎下跑第三名，落後頭馬3.75個馬位。最近10月5日出試從化草地1200米，早段領放，末段稍騎下以半個馬位之先勝出。初出有力一爭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Settled in mid-field, ridden top of home straight, checked 350m out, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居中間位置。直路初受催策。三百五十米處勒避。速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W) Moderately away, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, made no progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W) 出閘普通，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上毫無進展。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Waited with towards rear, briefly hampered 500m out, lost touch in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居後列，留力候上。五百米處一度受阻礙。直路上被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (5W5W) Raced in rear after slowly away, pushed along very wide into home straight, good headway early in home straight, no extra close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(5W5W) 出閘緩慢，居後列。入直路時受推策，走大外疊。直路上追前頗多，接近終點時再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Jumped awkwardly and lost ground, raced at tail, 8 to 9 lengths back in the middle stages, made some headway in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 出閘笨拙及失地，居包尾位置。中段落後八至九個馬位。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (1W1W) Raced in rear, unable to secure clear run until 200m out, ran on strongly to close on winner but always held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(1W1W) 居後列。未能望空直至二百米處。末段以勁勢上前，追近頭馬，但一直落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Jumped only fairly, settle 3Ls off leaders, couldn't quicken to challenge leaders final 300M. Never likely.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;出閘僅屬一般，落後領先馬匹三個馬位。最後三百米未能加速挑戰領先馬匹。從未看似有力爭勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; Stayed within striking distance from leaders, briefly held up 250M but lacked a strong response in the final stages.
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;保持落後領先馬匹不遠。二百五十米處一度受困，但末段對催策反應欠強勁。
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Bumped shortly after start, raced in midfield on the inside, hung out and made contact near 900M, moved a bit closer along the rail on turn, kept on well in straight to take a place, not quite able to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 起步後不久發生碰撞，居中間位置，走內疊。接近九百米處時外閃及發生觸踫。直路彎沿欄略為追近。直路上保持佳勢，跑獲季軍，但未能展開真正挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Well there, restrained to 3rd passing the 900M, did not find much room behind runners over 150M out, fought on well late to grab 2nd final strides.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 居好位，跑過九百米處時受約束，居第三位。一百五十米處在馬匹之後空位不足。末段以佳勢力拼，最後數步取得亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (4W1W) Settled in rear of mid-field, under pressure 550m out, unable to secure clear run until 300m out, stayed on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(4W1W) 居中間之後位置。五百五十米處受催策。未能望空直至三百米處。末段保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Never far off in a handy spot towards the center of track, couldn't quicken final 300M and was safely held by leaders. (No Vet findings.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;居前列，從未遠離領先馬匹，在跑道中央競跑。最後三百米未能加速，一直落後領先馬匹。（賽後接受獸醫檢查，並無發現任何明顯異常之處。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Ridden from moderate start from a wide barrier before settling just worse than midfield, found nothing under pressure in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 自外檔出閘普通，受催策，居中間稍後位置。直路上對催策毫無反應。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Taken back from a wide draw and settled near last 6Ls off the pace, gave limited response in the straight. Never threatened.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 自大外檔出閘，留居接近包尾位置，落後領放馬六個馬位。直路上對催策反應平平。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to fast; (4W3W5W) Caught racing wide without cover in midfield, failed to respond when placed under pressure 350M, eased when final 200M.
(Lame in left front leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏快步速;(4W3W5W) 居中間位置，走外疊，沒有遮擋。三百五十米處對催策毫無反應。最後二百米收慢。
（左前腿不良於行。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Jumped fairly, gradually recovered to one-out-one-back in 3rd travelling keenly at times, some 3L back making home bend, made modest headway in straight while shifting ground early on to just fail to reach 2nd on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘一般，逐漸恢復走勢，居第三位，落後一個馬位，走第二疊。不時搶口。轉直路彎時落後約三個馬位。直路早段斜跑，其後在直路上略為上前，僅未能在終點線上進佔亞席。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Ridden to take up running over 800M out, led on stands rail until finding no extra 150M out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;受催策，八百米處取得領先。沿外欄領放，一百五十米處再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Began only fairly, raced in midfield on the stands' side, ridden after passing 300M but only showed limited response, no clear run near 100M, one-paced thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;出閘僅屬一般，居中間位置，靠近外欄競跑。跑過三百米處後受催策，但反應僅屬平平。接近一百米處時未能望空，其後保持同速。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Raced in touch, pushed along to improve between horses from 300m out, led 100m out and soon in control, won readily.
