runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。自三百米處起受推策以在馬匹之間推進。一百米處取得領先，瞬即控制大局，輕鬆勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (1W2W) Hampered shortly after start, raced in midfield on the inside, there to turn, finished off well to take a place.
(Bled.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(1W2W) 起步後不久受阻礙，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎前居相同位置。末段衝刺良佳，跑獲季軍。
（流鼻血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W1W1W) Not far off 4-wide early stages, gradually improved to 2L 2nd 2-wide 900M out, kept on under pressure from a similar position into home straight but could find no extra 150M out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W1W1W) 早段落後領放馬不遠，走第四疊。逐漸上前，九百米處居第二位，落後兩個馬位，走第二疊。入直路時位置相若，在催策下保持走勢，但最後一百五十米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Gradually recovered from moderate start to over 3L back in 5th about 1000M out, drifted further off the fast pace to some 4L back around home bend, renewed effort inside final 300M to do best work late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘普通，其後逐漸恢復走勢，約一千米處居第五位，落後逾三個馬位。其後進一步落後步速快的領放馬，轉直路彎時落後約四個馬位。最後三百米重新發力，末段表現最佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W4W) Raced in touch with leaders, keen, unable to quicken under pressure over 300m out, no extra and lost ground final 150m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W4W) 跟隨領先馬匹，搶口。三百米處在催策下未能加速。最後一百五十米再無餘力及失地。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Average to begin, raced better than midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, finished off well to take 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘普通，居中間之前位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。末段衝刺良佳，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Average to begin, raced better than midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, angled out early in straight, finished off strongly to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘一般，居中間之前位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初向外移出。衝刺強勁，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (6W1W) Crowded shortly after start, dropped out from wide draw, followed runner-up through in home straight, ran on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(6W1W) 自外檔起步後不久受擠迫，墮後。直路上跟隨亞軍馬匹上前，衝刺良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W4W) Shifted in at start and made contact, raced behind midfield, 7 lengths back turning in, made some progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W4W) 起步時向內斜跑，與對手互相觸碰，居中間之後位置。轉入直路時落後七個馬位。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W) Began well, taken back to race 3 wide towards rear, 5 lengths back turning in, made little progress in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W) 出閘迅速，留居後列，走第三疊。入直路時落後五個馬位。直路上略為追前。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W2W) Ridden along from stalls, tracked pace out wide without cover, steadied for cover halfway out, bumped 350m out, struggling.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W2W) 出閘後受催策，跟隨領放馬，走外疊，沒有遮擋。半程時收慢以取得遮擋。三百五十米處發生碰撞。掙扎上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) Raced in touch with leaders, under pressure 500m out to chase leaders, dropped away quickly in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。五百米處受催策，追趕領先馬匹。直路上迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W1W) Average to begin, positioned 5 lengths behind the leader, same margin back on turn, made good progress in straight to take 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W1W) 出閘一般，落後領放馬五個馬位。直路彎落後相同距離。直路上追前甚多，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W1W) Clean jump, sent forward to take the lead, led by 3/4L turning in, kept on well to the line and scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W1W) 出閘俐落，受催策上前領放。入直路時領先四分三個馬位。末段保持佳勢，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W) Showed great speed to lead, set strong pace, pressed in front, headed 200m out, faded final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W) 展現甚快前速，取得領先，在快步速領放下受追迫。二百米處被超越。最後二百米力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Jumped awkwardly settling just worse than midfield in 9th, made no impression in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘笨拙，居中間稍後第九位。直路上毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W) Pressed leader, bumped and lost balance 300m out, dropped away quickly final 300m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W) 追迫領放馬。三百米處發生碰撞，失去平衡。最後三百米迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W) Soon led, pressed by rival in middle stages, quickened to a clear lead early straight, kept on well just only to be caught near line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W) 瞬即取得領先，中段受一駒追迫。直路早段加速帶離對手，保持佳勢，僅於接近終點時被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (5W2W3W) Tracked leaders, keen middle stages, unable to hold position final bend, eased when detached 200m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(5W2W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹，中段搶口。直路彎未能保持位置。二百米處被拋離，收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W) Fast break, made all, kicked three lengths clear 200m out, won unchallenged and going away.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W) 出閘迅速，一直領放。二百米處加速帶離三個馬位。在未受挑戰下拋離對手取勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W1W) Ridden along to lead, traveled nicely, kept on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W1W) 在催策下領放，走勢良佳。末段保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(-) (1W1W) Showed good speed to lead, quickened early in home straight to kick five lengths clear 200m out, eased close home and won impressively.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(-)(1W1W) 展現甚快前速以取得領先。直路初加速，二百米處帶離五個馬位。接近終點時收慢，勝姿悅目。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(-) (1W1W) Soon took up running from a wide barrier setting a steady pace on rail, drew over 3L clear upon straightening, eased closing stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(-)(1W1W) 自外檔出閘後瞬即帶頭，以平穩步速領放，走內欄。入直路時帶離逾三個馬位。末段在收慢下勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Moderately away from a wide draw, sent forward to race prominently, 2 wide, there to turn, took the lead early in straight, kept on well but unable to hold off the winner close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 自外檔出閘普通，受催策上前，居前列，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路早段取得領先。保持佳勢，但接近終點時未能抗衡頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W3W) From draw 14 went forward, in 3rd spot going into home turn, briefly in front 350M but couldn't hold off the first 3 finishers mid-straight, no extra late under top weight and lost 4th near line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W3W) 自大外檔出閘後上前。進入直路彎時居第三位。三百五十米處一度領先，但直路中段未能抗衡三甲馬匹。在負頂磅下末段再無餘力，接近終點時失去第四位。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W3W2W2W) In the group chasing leaders early stages, raced keenly and allowed to move closer to the pace passing 1000M, ran on same pace in the straight, lost 2nd inside 100M, weakened to 6th.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W3W2W2W) 早段追趕領先馬匹，搶口，跑過一千米處時獲許上前追近領放馬。直路上保持同速。一百米處失去第二位，其後轉弱，取得第六名。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W3W5W) Raced in rear after crowded and bumped out of stalls, headway halfway into mid-field, faded final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W3W5W) 出閘時受擠迫及發生碰撞，其後居後列。半程時追前至中間位置。最後二百米力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Raced keenly when being restrained for cover behind leader, in 3rd place turning home, held up for clear running 400M-50M before closing off well late to take 5th. Could have done better.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 在受約束以取得領放馬之後有遮擋的位置之際搶口。轉直路彎時居第三位。四百米處至五十米處之間受困而未能望空，末段以佳勢衝刺，跑獲第五名。本應可取得更好成績。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Began awkwardly, raced in mid-division along the fence, couldn't finish off under top weight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘笨拙，居中間位置，走內欄。在負頂磅下未能以勁勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W5W) Taken back from gate 9, raced at rear on outer, 6-1/2L back turning in, made some progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W5W) 自第九檔出閘後留居後列，走外疊。入直路時落後六個半馬位。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W2W2W) Settled in mid-field, had to wait for run turning into home straight, unable to secure clear run until 200m out, stayed on for pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W2W2W) 居中間位置。轉入直路時須等待空位出現。未能望空直至二百米處。在催策下保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (1W1W) Moderately away from gate 1, raced behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, angled out early in straight, cleared after passing 250M, finished off very strongly to score. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘普通，居中間之後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路早段向外移出。跑過二百五十米處後望空。末段衝刺凌厲，掄元。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W1W1W) Held up last, still in last place top of home straight, switched for clear run 300m out, unable to improve position.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 留居包尾位置。直路初仍居包尾位置。三百米處轉換跑線以望空。未能推進上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(-) (1W2W) Reserved in a position behind midfield, picked up in good style 300M, charged home late but couldn't get past winner. Game in defeat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(-)(1W2W) 留居中間之後位置。三百米處加速良佳。末段衝刺強勁，但未能超越頭馬，在力拼下僅敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(-) (1W1W) Rail position in rear, had to wait for run turning into home straight, ran on strongly final 200m, lost out only narrowly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(-)(1W1W) 居後列，走內欄。轉入直路時須等待空位出現。最後二百米衝刺強勁，僅以短距離之差落敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W2W) Raced in rear, hampered 350m out, secure clear run 300m out, ran on strongly but no match for winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W2W) 居後列。三百五十米處受阻礙。三百米處望空。以勁勢上前，但未能抗衡頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(+) (2W3W) Slowly away, raced 2 wide behind midfield, there to turn, no clear run early in straight, cleared 300M, finished off strongly, just beaten by a narrow margin.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(+)(2W3W) 出閘緩慢，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路早段未能望空。三百米處望空，末段衝刺強勁，僅以短距離之差見負。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W3W) Crowded on jumping, raced 2 wide at rear, there to turn, closed off well to make frame without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W3W) 躍出時受擠迫，居後列，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。衝刺良佳，取得第四名，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W2W) Away well, raced in midfield on the inside, 2 wide from 600M, hard ridden after passing 400M, took the lead 200M, kept on well but unable to hold off the winner final 50M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W2W) 出閘迅速，居中間位置，走內疊。自六百米處起走第二疊。跑過四百米處後受力策。二百米處取得領先。保持佳勢，但最後五十米未能抗衡頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) Stayed close enough to leaders, quickened up well passing 350M, led nearing 150M, held on well for the lead final stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 保持緊隨領先馬匹。跑過三百五十米處時加速良佳。接近一百五十米處時取得領先。末段以佳勢力拼，保住領先位置。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Settled in rear of mid-field, driven 500m out, shifted right final 200m, stayed on but no threat to leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 居中間之後位置。五百米處受催策。最後二百米向內斜跑。保持走勢，但未能威脅領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Three wide in rear of mid-field without cover, good headway on bend, ran on well to lead 100m out, on top from there.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。直路彎追前甚多。以佳勢上前，一百米處取得領先，其後保持領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Tracked leaders, under pressure 600m out, one paced and unable to get on terms with winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。六百米處受催策。保持同速，未能追上頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) Jumped well from gate 11, raced prominently on the outside, 1/2L back turning in, challenged the leader early in straight, peaked on run near 200M, kept on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 自第十一檔出閘迅速，居前列，走外疊。入直路時落後半個馬位。直路早段挑戰領放馬。接近二百米處時未能再增速。保持穩勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W3W3W) Chased leader, remained prominent 900m out, switched and under pressure 500m out, gave ground final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W3W3W) 追趕領放馬。九百米處保持居前列。五百米處轉換跑線，受催策。最後二百米墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W2W) Began well from a wide draw, sent forward to race prominently on the outside, took the lead after passing 850M, led by 1/4L turning in, peaked and headed 300M, weakened final 200M. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W2W) 自外檔出閘迅速，受催策上前，居前列，走外疊。跑過八百五十米處後取得領先。入直路時領先四分一個馬位。三百米處未能再增速，被超越。最後二百米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Led steadily, kept finding when challenged by rivals in the straight, couldn't hold off winner passing 150M but continued bravely to hold 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 以平穩步速領放。直路上受對手挑戰時持續力拼。跑過一百五十米處時未能抗衡頭馬，但繼續奮勇力拼，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W2W2W) Prominent, ridden to chase leader 500m out, struggled to hold position in home straight, flattened out final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W2W2W) 居前列。五百米處受催策追趕領放馬。直路上難以保持位置。最後一百米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W2W2W) Stepped away cleanly from barrier 9, raced prominently to be 3/4L outside the leader, stuck to the task and dug deep to fend off a late challenger.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W2W2W) 自第九檔出閘俐落，居前列，落後四分三個馬位，在領放馬外側競跑。持續力拼，末段力拒對手的挑戰勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to fast; (4W3W) Raced very wide without cover throughout, struggled to maintain position on bend, gave ground final 300m.
The jockey's whip was accidentally knocked from his grasp.
runnerrecords.incident_eng: The jockey's whip was accidentally knocked from his grasp.
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏快步速;(4W3W) 沿途走大外疊，沒有遮擋。直路彎難以保持位置。最後三百米墮退。
騎師馬鞭被擊中脫手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) Made contact at start, raced in 3rd, 1-1/2L back turning in, hit the front approaching 200M, kept on strongly to the line and scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 起步時發生觸碰，居第三位。入直路時落後一個半馬位。趨近二百米處時取得領先，保持勁勢至終點，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Began awkwardly, raced in midfield on the inside, 3 lengths back, saved ground on turn, no clear run early in straight, cleared 200M, finished off well to take a place.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘笨拙，居中間位置，落後三個馬位，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路早段未能望空。二百米處望空，末段衝刺良佳，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W3W) Moderately away, raced better than midfield on the inside, commenced move 650M, 3 wide turning in, took the lead 300M, kept on well but unable to hold off the first two final 50M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W3W) 出閘普通，居中間之前位置，走內疊。六百五十米處開始上前。入直路時走第三疊，三百米處取得領先，保持佳勢，但最後五十米不敵首兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W4W) Raced very wide throughout, mid division, pushed along 500m out, not beaten far.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W4W) 居中間位置，沿途走大外疊。五百米處受推策。所負不遠。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W2W) Awkward start and lost ground, recovered to settle rail position in mid-field, angled off rail 600m out, one paced under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W2W) 出閘笨拙及失地，其後恢復走勢，居中間位置，走內欄。六百米處移離內欄。末段在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Away well from the inside draw and trailed the leader, finished off only fairly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 自內檔出閘迅速，跟隨領放馬。衝刺僅屬一般。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W3W) Sat on pace 2 wide, gave ground quickly entering the Straight, never a factor.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W3W) 居前列，走第二疊。入直路時迅速墮退。從未有力一爭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Keen in wide position, quickly left behind from 400m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 搶口，走外疊。自四百米處起迅速被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W6W) Crowded after the start, reserved near last 7Ls off the good pace, brought wide to challenge turning home and made up a lot of ground under top weight to take lead close home. Impressive win.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W6W) 起步後受擠迫，留居接近包尾位置，落後步速甚快的領放馬七個馬位。轉直路彎時移出外疊以展開挑戰。在負頂磅下追前甚多，接近終點時取得領先。贏得漂亮。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W2W) Shared 6th on rail about 3L off pace early, gained closer to just over 2L back in 5th in slackened tempo home bend, switched out for a tight run just inside the 300M gaining 3rd 50M out. (Questioned for his riding in straight.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W2W) 早段並居第六位，落後領放馬約三個馬位，走內欄。直路彎在步速減慢下追近至第五位，落後稍逾兩個馬位。跑過三百米處後向外移出至窄位。最後五十米進佔第三位。（騎師被查詢有關他在直路上的騎法。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (1W1W) In midfield along the fence, travelled well into straight but had to wait for a run, shifted lane 250M to continue into clear running before seeing it out strongly to win by 1.5L.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。入直路時走勢良佳，但須等待空位出現。二百五十米處轉換跑線以繼續望空，其後衝刺強勁，以一個半馬位之先掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W5W) Made contact at start, raced towards rear on the outside, 4 to 5 lengths back turning in, made good progress in straight to be nearest on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W5W) 起步時被觸碰，居後列，走外疊。入直路時落後四至五個馬位。直路上追前頗多，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Bumped start, raced behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, made no progress in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 起步時發生碰撞，居中間之後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上毫無進展。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W2W3W) Sat behind midfield 2 wide, made no impression. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W2W3W) 居中間之後位置，走第二疊。毫無表現。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W1W2W) Impeded and forced to steady out of stalls, rail position in mid-field, angled out to make run 500m out, ran on well final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W1W2W) 出閘時受阻，被迫收慢，沿欄居中間位置。五百米處向外移出取位。最後二百米以佳勢追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W2W) Soon taken across from a wide barrier for an inside run, travelled tight in rear before making steady headway home bend, came to challenge under pressure upon straightening, ran on steadily without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W2W) 自外檔出閘，瞬即切入內疊，居後列，緊迫競跑，直路彎穩步追前。入直路時在催策下上前挑戰。穩步上前，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (2W2W2W4W) Taken back from a wide draw, raced 2 wide towards rear, angled out approaching 500M, finished off strongly to take 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(2W2W2W4W) 自外檔出閘後留居後列，走第二疊。趨近五百米處時向外移出。以勁勢衝刺，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (3W2W2W5W) Dropped out from widest draw, pushed along widest into home straight, tended to hang right in home straight, ran on strongly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(3W2W2W5W) 自最外檔出閘後墮後。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。直路上傾向內閃。以勁勢上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W4W) Jumped with them, raced slightly better than midfield on the outside, 3 lengths back turning in, peaked early in straight, kept on same pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W4W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間稍前位置，走外疊。入直路時落後三個馬位。直路早段未能再增速，保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Bumped out of stalls, settled in rear of mid-field, tight for room early in home straight, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘時發生碰撞，居中間之後位置。直路初空位不足。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Raced in rear after bumped leaving stalls, had to wait for run turning into home straight, unable to quicken.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 出閘時與對手互相碰撞，其後居後列。入直路時須等待空位出現。末段未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W) Waited with in rear, ridden top of home straight, tight for room 200m out, never going pace to get competitive.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W) 居後列，留力候上。直路初受催策。二百米處受緊迫，從未能加速以爭勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W3W) Settled in rear of mid-field, ridden top of home straight, ran on well final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W3W) 居中間之後位置。直路初受催策。最後二百米走勢良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W4W6W) Jumped only fairly, raced keenly and refused to settle due to the pace being run outside of standard time, improved his position on outside passing 800M but was left without a finishing effort in the straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W4W6W) 出閘僅屬一般。由於賽事步速較標準時間為慢，搶口及不願穩定走勢。跑過八百米處時沿外疊追前，但在直路上衝刺乏力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W3W3W4W) Travelled 3-wide in 8th in rear of midfield, commenced move making home bend swinging widest into straight, ran on under pressure without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W3W3W4W) 居中間之後第八位，走第三疊。轉直路彎時開始上前，入直路時移出最外疊。在催策下上前，未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W2W2W) Tracked leaders, unable to pick up for pressure from 500m out, gave ground final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W2W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。自五百米處起受催策，但未能加速。最後二百米墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Bumped start and unbalanced, raced slightly behind midfield on the inside, 5 lengths back turning in, not enough room early in straight, cleared 300M, made some progress thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 起步時發生碰撞，失去平衡，居中間稍後位置，走內疊。入直路時落後五個馬位。直路初空位不足。三百米處望空。其後略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(-) (2W3W) Settled in midfield 2-wide, responded well early straight when asked, kept chasing to obtain the lead nearing 100M and just held off fast-finishing 2nd for a gutsy win.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(-)(2W3W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。直路初對催策反應良佳。持續追趕對手，接近一百米處時取得領先。末段在奮勇力拼下力拒衝刺強勁的亞軍馬匹僅勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W) Raced in touch with leaders, unable to secure clear run until 300m out, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。未能望空直至三百米處。未能增速以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W2W) Crowded shortly after start, raced behind midfield on the inside, 3 to 4 lengths back turning in, unable to obtain clear run early in straight, found daylight near 150M, made some progress thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W2W) 起步後不久受擠迫，居中間之後位置，走內疊。入直路時落後三至四個馬位。直路早段未能望空。接近一百五十米處時望空，其後略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W) Bumped out of stalls, pressed leaders, driven along 500m out to chase leaders, weakened quickly in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W) 出閘時發生碰撞，追迫領先馬匹。五百米處受催策，追趕領先馬匹。直路上迅速轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W3W) Made contact at start, positioned 3 wide, 3 lengths or so back, no cover on turn, kept on same pace in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W3W) 起步時發生觸碰，落後約三個馬位，走第三疊。直路彎沒有遮擋。直路上保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W3W3W) Settled well back from the widest draw, made short-lived effort between the 800 and 600M, made no further impression in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W3W3W) 自最外檔出閘後遙居於後。八百米處至六百米處之間一度發力。直路上再無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W5W) Dropped out from wide draw, pushed along wide into home straight, no extra final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W5W) 自外檔出閘後墮後。入直路時受推策，走外疊。最後二百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W3W) Out with rest, raced 2 wide in midfield, 3 lengths or so back, bumped near 500M, kept on evenly in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W3W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間位置，落後約三個馬位，走第二疊。接近五百米處時發生碰撞。直路上保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W2W) Taken back to race 2 wide towards rear, slightly improved on turn, made contact near 350M, finished off well to take a place, no threat to the first two.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W2W) 留居後列，走第二疊。直路彎略為推進。接近三百五十米處時發生觸碰。衝刺良佳，跑獲季軍，但未能威脅首兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W4W) From wide draw dropped back to race near the rear early, improved to midfield passing 1000M when pace slackened, asked for maximum effort 400M but only held ground in a steady run to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W4W) 自最外檔出閘，早段墮居後列。跑過一千米處賽事步速減慢時推進至中間位置。四百米處受全力催策，但末段走勢平穩，僅能保持位置。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W2W3W3W) Sat towards the rear 3 wide, stayed on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W2W3W3W) 居後列，走第三疊。末段保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W4W) Bumped on jumping, raced 2 wide at rear, angled out after passing 500M, no daylight early in straight, made some progress thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W4W) 躍出時與對手互相碰撞，居後列，走第二疊。跑過五百米處後向外移出。直路早段未能望空，其後略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(+) (3W5W) Taken back from a wide draw, raced 3 wide with cover towards rear, a bit closer in the middle stages, very wide turning in, made good progress in straight to take a place.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(+)(3W5W) 自外檔出閘後留居後列，走第三疊，有遮擋。中段略為追近。入直路時走大外疊。直路上追前頗多，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W) Jumped with them, raced 2 wide behind midfield, there to turn, difficult to obtain clear run early in straight, cleared after passing 250M, made minor progress thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路早段難以望空。跑過二百五十米處後望空，其後略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Dropped back to the rear on jumping from a wide draw, had a ground saving trip on the inside, had some work to do 400M, closed off fastest to finish a close 5th, nearest at the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 自外檔出閘後墮居包尾位置，走內疊節省腳程。四百米處仍落後頗遠。末段衝刺最快，取得第五名。過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W3W) Tracked pace out wide, driven 500m out, dropped away quickly in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W3W) 跟隨領放馬，走外疊。五百米處受催策。直路上迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(+) (2W2W) Commenced well, raced 2 wide better than midfield, over-raced in the early and middle stages, 2 lengths or so back turning in, kept on well in straight to make frame, not quite able to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(+)(2W2W) 出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。早段及中段搶口。入直路時落後約兩個馬位。直路上保持佳勢，取得第四名，但未能展開真正挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W1W) From wide draw went forward and eventually crossed to the lead before home turn, responded well under top weight mid-straight, was all out closing stages just couldn't hold off the fast finishing winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W1W) 自外檔出閘後上前，直路彎前切入領放。直路中段在負頂磅下對催策反應良佳。末段在力拼下僅不敵衝刺凌厲的頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Tracked leader 2-wide, came under pressure to challenge on straightening gaining upper hand just inside the 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 跟隨領放馬，走第二疊。入直路時在催策下展開挑戰。跑過一百米處後佔得上風。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W2W) Raced prominently, upsides leader entering home straight, unable to stay with that rival, stuck to task, closed up final 100m but always held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W2W) 居前列。入直路時與領放馬並跑，其後未能跟上該駒。持續力拼，最後一百米追近，但一直落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(-) (3W2W) Well there 3-wide early obtaining 2-wide position onto home bend, gradually faded under pressure inside final 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(-)(3W2W) 早段居好位，走第三疊。開始轉直路彎時走第二疊。最後二百米在催策下逐漸力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Tracked leaders, ridden along to hold position 800m out, one paced under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹。八百米處在催策下保持位置。在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W2W) Recovered to first few briefly after moderate start, gradually taken back from the 1000M to be over 3L back in midfield at about 700M out, made short-lived progress early in straight but unable to sustain effort inside final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W2W) 起步一般，其後恢復走勢，一度進佔前列。自一千米處起逐漸留後，約七百米處居中間位置，落後逾三個馬位。直路初一度發力，但最後一百米無以為繼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Shifted in and bumped out of stalls, raced in touch with leaders, tight for room early in home straight, weakened final 150m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘時向內斜跑，與對手互相碰撞，緊隨領先馬匹。直路初受緊迫。最後一百五十米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Jumped well, raced in 2nd, 2 wide, a length back turning in, kept on well in straight without threatening the winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 出閘迅速，居第二位，走第二疊。入直路時落後一個馬位。直路上保持佳勢，但未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W3W) Taken back from gate 9, raced towards rear on the outside, 5-1/4L back turning in, made minor progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W3W) 自第九檔出閘，留居後列，走外疊。入直路時落後五又四分一個馬位。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) Disputed led, led from 1000m out, under pressure 350m out, headed by runner-up 300m out, flattened out final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 爭奪領先。自一千米處起領先。三百五十米處受催策。三百米處被亞軍馬匹超越。最後一百米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Very fast; (3W3W3W3W) Pressed forward from a poor draw before settling 3-wide just worse than midfield in 9th just under 8L off the pace, dropped out of contention rounding home bend from 750M out.
(Sustained a small cut to left front leg.)
runnerrecords.healthissue_eng: (Sustained a small cut to left front leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
極快步速;(3W3W3W3W) 自外檔出閘，受催策上前。其後居中間稍後的第九位，落後領放馬近八個馬位，走第三疊。自七百五十米處起轉直路彎時墮退，再無爭勝機會。
（左前腿輕微割傷。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W4W) Three wide in mid-field, ridden early in home straight, one paced under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W4W) 居中間位置，走第三疊。直路早段受催策，在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(-) (2W2W) From draw 12 pushed forward to track leader, took over nearing 350M and fought hard, shifted in under pressure 150M causing interference to rivals, lost lead inside 100M and caught by 2nd near line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(-)(2W2W) 自第十二檔出閘，受推策以跟隨領放馬。接近三百五十米處時取得領先，力拼。一百五十米處在催策下向內斜跑，干擾對手。最後一百米失去領先位置，接近終點時被亞軍馬匹超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (4W2W) Bumped start, raced in 3rd, 2 to 3 lengths back turning in, kept on well in straight to take a place without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(4W2W) 起步時發生碰撞，居第三位。入直路時落後兩至三個馬位。直路上保持佳勢，跑獲季軍，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(-) (1W1W) Showed good speed to lead, set strong pace, headed by winner 250m out, sticking to task, just lost third.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(-)(1W1W) 展現甚快前速，取得領先，以快步速領放。二百五十米處被頭馬超越。末段持續力拼，僅失去季席。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Emerged as leader passing 1300M, took them along at good pace middle stages, still going well passing 400M then kept on strongly final stages under big weight to hold pursuing rivals at bay. Won 4 from 4.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 跑過千三米處時取得領先。中段以快步速領放。跑過四百米處時仍保持佳勢。末段在負重磅下保持勁勢，力拒緊追的對手掄元。迄今四戰四勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Showed good speed to lead, keen early stages, three lengths clear 800m out, margin reduced turning into home straight, quickened early in home straight and soon in command.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 展現甚快前速，領放。早段搶口。八百米處帶離三個馬位。轉入直路時領先距離收窄。直路初加速，瞬即控制大局。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Jumped well, sent forward to take the lead, travelled well to turn, kept on strongly in straight, won comfortably.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。直路彎前走勢良佳。直路上保持勁勢。輕鬆勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Bumped on jumping, sent forward to race prominently, took the lead near 900M, led by a length turning in, kept on very well in straight, easily scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 躍出時被碰撞，受催策上前，居前列。接近九百米處時取得領先。入直路時領先一個馬位。直路上保持甚佳走勢，輕鬆勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Very slow; (2W3W) Dropped back to the rear, raced keenly with the pace of the event being run outside of standard time, 10Ls off leader 400M, couldn't make up ground.
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
極慢步速;(2W3W) 墮居後列，搶口，賽事步速較標準時間為慢。四百米處落後領放馬十個馬位。未能追前。
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(-) (2W4W) In rear after crowded and steadied at start, pushed along widest into home straight, closed on winner late on but always held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(-)(2W4W) 起步時受擠迫及收慢，其後居後列。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。末段追近頭馬，但一直落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Sluggish start, settled in mid-field, had to wait for run turning into home straight, ran on strongly final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 起步緩慢，居中間位置。轉入直路時須等待空位出現。最後一百米衝刺強勁。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Dropped back to race in last from a wide draw, moved closer 600M, unleashed a strong turn of foot on straightening to take lead 200M, won going away.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 自大外檔出閘後墮居包尾位置。六百米處追近。入直路時加速強勁，二百米處取得領先。帶離勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W1W) Dropped out from widest draw, shuffled back, still in last place turning into home straight, strong run final 200m, just failed.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W1W) 自大外檔出閘，留居後列。轉入直路時仍居包尾位置。最後二百米衝刺強勁，僅敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W3W) Bumped shortly after start, positioned 2 wide, 2 lengths or so back, 3 wide after passing 550M, same margin back turning in, showed limited response early in straight, weakened gradually final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W3W) 起步後不久被碰撞，落後約兩個馬位，走第二疊。跑過五百五十米處後走第三疊。入直路時落後相同距離。直路早段對催策反應平平，最後一百米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Dropped out from widest draw, forced to steady on heels 800m out, bumped 350m out, followed winner through 200m out, stayed on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 自大外檔出閘後墮後。八百米處被迫收慢避開他駒後蹄。三百五十米處發生碰撞，二百米處跟隨頭馬上前。末段保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Crowded and bumped at start, outpaced in rear, ridden along top of home straight, soon well held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 起步時受擠迫，被碰撞。未能跟上步速，居後列。直路初受催策，瞬即遙遙落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Shifted out at start and made contact, raced slightly behind midfield on the outside, kept on same pace in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 起步時向外斜跑，與對手互相觸碰。居中間稍後位置，走外疊。直路上保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W) Shifted out and bumped out of stalls, rail position in mid-field, struggled to hold position from 500m out, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W) 出閘時向外斜跑，發生碰撞，居中間位置，走內欄。自五百米處起難以保持位置。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Raced wide, shuffled back mid-race, pushed along widest into home straight, did not have speed to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 走外疊。中段墮後。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。未能增速以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W3W3W4W) Prominent early settling 3-wide in midfield, gave ground quickly from 600M out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W3W3W4W) 早段居前列，其後居中間位置，走第三疊。自六百米處起迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Raced in touch with leaders, ridden top of home straight, strong run to lead 200m out, on top from there.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹。直路初受催策。走勢強勁，二百米處取得領先，其後保持領先至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Jumped well, raced slightly better than midfield, saved ground on turn, no clear run early in straight, cleared 300M, finished off strongly to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，居中間稍前位置。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初未能望空。三百米處望空。衝刺強勁，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W5W) Made contact at start, raced slightly behind midfield on the outside, 5 lengths back turning in, kept on same pace in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W5W) 起步時發生觸碰，居中間稍後位置，走外疊。入直路時落後五個馬位。直路上保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Commenced well, raced better than midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, took the lead 200M, kept on well to the line and scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。二百米處取得領先，保持佳勢至終點，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (2W3W) Began only fairly and made contact, raced 2 wide behind midfield, 3 wide turning in, finished off strongly to take 2nd, just beaten by a head.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(2W3W) 出閘僅屬一般，與對手互相觸碰，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。入直路時走第三疊，衝刺強勁，取得亞軍，僅以一馬頭位之差見負。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (1W1W) Taken back from gate 9, raced at rear on the inside, saved ground on turn, no clear run early in straight, cleared near 250M, closed off well to take a place without threatening the first two.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(1W1W) 自第九檔出閘後留居包尾位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路早段未能望空。接近二百五十米處時望空。末段以佳勢衝刺，跑入季席，但未能威脅首兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (3W3W) Slightly slow out and crowded, raced 3 wide with cover behind midfield, 4 lengths or so back, same margin back on turn, made good progress in straight to take a place. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(3W3W) 出閘稍慢，受擠迫，居中間之後位置，落後約四個馬位，走第三疊，有遮擋。直路彎落後相同距離。直路上追前甚多，跑獲季軍。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) From draw 1 tracked leaders on inside but was held up for clear running over final 350M and not tested to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘，跟隨領先馬匹，走內疊，但最後三百五十米受困而未能望空。未能施為至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (2W5W) Tracked leaders, switched wide for clear run 600m out, ran on well to lead 200m out, headed by winner 100m out and just failed.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(2W5W) 跟隨領先馬匹。六百米處移出外疊以望空。以佳勢上前，二百米處取得領先。一百米處被頭馬超越，僅敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Showed good speed to lead, kicked 350m out and ran on well, pressed by runner-up to line and just prevailed.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 展現甚快前速，取得領先。三百五十米處加速，以佳勢上前。被亞軍馬匹追迫至終點，險勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Showed great speed to lead, under pressure 400m out, headed 200m out, weakened final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 前速甚快，取得領先。四百米處受催策。二百米處被超越。最後一百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Tracked leader, travelled strongly to lead early in home straight, pressed on 250m out, headed by winner 100m out, stayed on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 跟隨領放馬。直路初走勢強勁，取得領先。二百五十米處受催策。一百米處被頭馬超越，保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Began well, positioned 1 out 1 back, there to turn, hit the front 250M, kept on well to the line and scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 出閘迅速，居第二疊第二位。直路彎前居相同位置，二百五十米處取得領先，末段保持佳勢，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Away well to lead, set good pace in first half of the race, shifted away from running rail on straightening then kept on well only to be caught by first three in closing stages. (Riding tactics questioned.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 出閘迅速，領放。前半程以快步速領放。入直路時移離內欄，其後保持佳勢，僅於末段被三甲馬匹超越。（騎師被查詢競跑策略。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Commenced well, raced in 2nd, 2 wide, there to turn, challenged the leader early in straight, hit the front approaching 200M, kept on well to the line and scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘迅速，居第二位，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路早段挑戰領放馬。趨近二百米處時取得領先。末段保持佳勢，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W2W) Soon led, made all setting a sound pace, ridden clear over 200M out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W2W) 瞬即帶頭，以快步速領放。二百米處在催策下帶離對手。

formguide.comments_eng: South African PP, a 5-year-old gelding, by Vercingetorix from Makiwara, a daughter of Smart Strike. Horses by the same sire include Smiling Champion and Super Commander. This fellow hand thirteen starts for four wins (including a group three over 1600m and a group three over 1800m) and five placings (including a 3yo group one over 2000m and a group two over 1600m). He was given three trials for one win in Hong Kong. In the latest trial, he shared the lead and won by 1/2L under pressure, over 1200m AWT in Conghua on October 8. Prefer to take a watching brief to see how he shapes at his local debut.
formguide.comments_chi: 「民族英雄」(Vercingetorix)之後，在港同父馬包括「威威神駒」及「令才」等駒，生母出自Smart Strike。來港前在南非十三戰得四勝五位，頭馬包括一場1600米三級賽及一場1800米三級賽，上名賽事包括一場2000米三歲一級賽及一場1600米二級賽。抵港後三次試閘得一勝。最近10月8日出試從化泥地1200米，早段並頭領放，末段力策下以半個馬位之先勝出。初出暫宜觀望。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Box seat, unable to secure clear run until 350m out, ran on well to edge ahead final 50m in tight finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居包廂位置。未能空直至三百五十米處。以佳勢追前，最後五十米取得領先，僅勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Box seat, unable to secure clear run until 150m out, strong run to lead 100m out, won comfortably.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 居包廂位置，未能望空直至一百五十米處。走勢強勁，一百米處取得領先，輕鬆勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W2W) Tracked leaders against rail, well placed into home straight, headway between horses from 300m out, stayed on steadily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。入直路時居好位。自三百米處起在馬匹之間追前。保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Shifted out shortly after start and made contact, raced 2 wide better than midfield, showed very good response in straight, took the lead 250M, kept on very well to the line, easily scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 起步後不久向外斜跑，與對手互相觸碰，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。直路上對催策反應甚佳。二百五十米處取得領先。保持甚佳走勢至終點，從容勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(-) (2W3W) Sat midfield 2 wide, checked at the 800M, took some time to respond in the Straight, made very good late ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(-)(2W3W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。八百米處勒避。直路上需時對催策作出反應。末段追前甚多。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W4W) Slowly away, settled in mid-field, switched for clear run top of home straight, stayed on steadily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W4W) 出閘緩慢，居中間位置。直路初向外移出以望空。保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W2W) Soon prominent, pushed into lead 200m out, asserted and in control final 100m, won readily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W2W) 瞬即居前列。受推策，二百米處取得領先。最後一百米控制大局，穩操勝券。從容取勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (1W1W) Bumped shortly after start, raced towards rear on the inside, saved ground on turn, made good progress in straight to make frame. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(1W1W) 起步後不久被碰撞，居後列，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上追前甚多，取得第四名。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W1W1W) Waited with towards rear, driven along 350m out, crowded 200m out, stayed on but never going pace to get competitive.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W1W1W) 居後列，留力候上。三百五十米處受催策。二百米處受擠迫。保持走勢，但從未能加速以爭勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (1W2W) Sat towards the rear on the rail, stayed on strongly to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(1W2W) 居後列，走內欄。末段保持勁勢，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Taken back to race 2 wide behind midfield, there to turn, no clear run early in straight, cleared approaching 200M, made good progress thereafter to take 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 留居中間之後位置，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路初未能望空。趨近二百米處時望空。其後追前甚多，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(-) (2W2W) Settled towards the rear, had some work to do top of the straight, held up 350M then hit the line well to claim 3rd. Encouraging run after lengthy break.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(-)(2W2W) 居後列。直路初落後頗遠。三百五十米處受困，其後以佳勢衝刺，跑獲季軍。久休復出，表現令人鼓舞。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W) Mid-field, briefly had to wait for run 400m out, headway after, stayed on at the one pace final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W) 居中間位置。四百米處一度須等待空位，其後上前。最後二百米保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Settled towards the rear, stayed on fairly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 居後列，保持一般走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(+) (1W1W) Clean jump, sent forward to take the lead, led by 3/4L turning in, kept on well in straight but unable to hold off the winner close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(+)(1W1W) 出閘俐落，受催策上前領放。入直路時領先四分三個馬位。直路上保持佳勢，但接近終點時未能抗衡頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Box seat, travelled smoothly into home straight, stayed on well but no match for winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居包廂位置。入直路時走勢暢順。末段保持佳勢，但不敵頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Made all, keen under restraint, kicked early in home straight and ran on well, margin reduced closing stages but always doing enough.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 一放到底。在約束下搶口。直路早段加速，走勢良佳。末段領先距離收窄，但一直保持佳勢，穩操勝券。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W2W) Jumped awkwardly, obtained a midfield position along the inside, brought wide 300M to find clear running but responded only fairly. (Jockey - didn't travel well during the event and changed stride on a number of occasions.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W2W) 出閘笨拙，居中間位置，走內疊。三百米處移出外疊以望空，但對催策反應僅屬一般。（騎師表示，坐騎沿途走勢欠佳，數度轉腳。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W3W) Moderately away, raced better than midfield on the inside, angled out after passing 600M, 1-3/4L back turning in, kept on evenly in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W3W) 出閘普通，居中間之前位置，走內疊。跑過六百米處後向外移出。入直路時落後一又四分三個馬位。直路上保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Sat on pace, traveled comfortably, closed off strongly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居前列。走勢暢順。衝刺強勁。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Pressed forward from a wide draw to lead about 1000M out, obtained rails run in front onto first turn and steadied up pace, headed briefly on straightening but soon re-gained advantage only to be worn down again over 100M out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 自外檔出閘後受催策上前，約一千米處取得領先。開始轉首個彎位時移入內欄領放，減慢步速。入直路時一度被超越，但瞬即再度領先。僅在一百米處再度被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Tracked leaders against rail, had to wait for run turning into home straight, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。轉入直路時須等待空位出現。速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Made running, challenged from top of home straight, headed 150m out, edged left but stuck to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 領放。自直路初起受對手挑戰。一百五十米處被超越。末段向外斜跑，但持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Very fast(+) (2W2W2W3W) Sat towards rear, pressed on near the 700M, responded reasonably well when asked (See Incident Report).
(Lame in right front leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
極快步速(+)(2W2W2W3W) 居後列。接近七百米處時受催策。末段對催策反應不俗。（見競賽事件報告。）
（右前腿不良於行。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Ridden along from stalls to race prominently, challenged leader top of home straight, flattened out final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘後受催策，居前列。直路初挑戰領放馬。最後二百米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W2W2W) Began well, raced 2 wide in midfield, 3 lengths or so back turning in, made minor progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W2W2W) 出閘迅速，居中間位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後約三個馬位。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W2W) Settled mainly in 5th on rail, did not find much room between runners early in straight, kept on same pace under pressure without quickening inside final 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W2W) 大多居第五位，走內欄。直路早段在馬匹之間空位不足。最後二百米受催策時保持同速，未能增速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W2W2W3W) Out with rest, raced 2 wide, 1 to 2 lengths back, similar position on turn, took the lead 200M, kept on well but unable to hold off the winner late, just beaten by a neck.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W2W2W3W) 與對手同步躍出，落後一至兩個馬位，走第二疊。直路彎居相若位置。二百米處取得領先。保持佳勢，但末段未能抗衡頭馬，僅以一馬頸位之差落敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W2W3W) Settled well back from a wide barrier and waited with, ran on in home straight, never nearer.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W2W3W) 自外檔出閘，遙居於後，留力候上。直路上追前，以末段最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W) Taken back from a wide draw, raced 2 wide at rear, found rail 550M, 7 lengths back turning in, made some headway in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W) 自外檔出閘，留居後列，走第二疊。五百五十米處移入內欄。轉入直路時落後七個馬位。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W3W) Shifted in, bumped and lost balance out of stalls, raced in rear of mid-field, effort 500m out, eased once well held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W3W) 出閘時向內斜跑，與對手互相碰撞及失去平衡。居中間之後位置。五百米處發力上前。遙遙落後時隨即收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W2W) Chased leader, challenged and improved to lead top of home straight, soon headed by winner 250m out, faded final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W2W) 追趕領放馬。直路初展開挑戰及上前取得領先。二百五十米處瞬即被頭馬超越。最後一百米力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Bumped shortly after start, rail position in rear of mid-field, driven on bend, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 起步後不久發生碰撞，居中間之後位置，走內欄。直路彎受催策。速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) In last few to straight, never nearer.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 直路前居最後數位之內。以末段最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W4W) Bumped shortly after start, positioned 3 wide with cover, 2 to 3 lengths back, similar position on turn, kept on same pace in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W4W) 起步後不久發生碰撞，落後兩至三個馬位，走第三疊，有遮擋。直路彎居相若位置。直路上保持同速。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Began well from gate 1, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, no clear run early in straight, cleared 300M, finished off very strongly to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初未能望空。三百米處望空。末段衝刺凌厲，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (3W3W) From wide draw dropped back to race at the rear further back than intended, 9Ls off the pace middle stages, still some work to do top of the straight, closed off fastest to lead inside 150M. Won convincingly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(3W3W) 自外檔出閘，留居較賽前部署為後的後列位置。中段落後領放馬九個馬位。直路初仍落後頗遠。衝刺最快，一百五十米處取得領先。從容勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Tracked leaders against rail, well placed into home straight and followed winner through 350m out, stayed on well but always held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。入直路時居好位。三百五十米處跟隨頭馬上前。保持佳勢，但一直落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Raced in touch with leaders, wide on bend, improved to lead over 200m out, tended to edge left in front, headed late on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 居領先馬匹之後的啣接位置。直路彎走外疊。推進上前，二百米處取得領先。在居前競跑下傾向外閃。末段被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Sat midfield 2 wide, stayed on nicely.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。末段保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W4W) Wide throughout, made contact with rival when improving into contention on bend, weakened 200m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W4W) 沿途走外疊。直路彎在上前爭勝之際與對手互相觸碰。二百米處轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W3W) Settled near last early stages, moved closer to midfield approaching 500M, ran on well towards the line getting up for 4th late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W3W) 早段居接近包尾位置。趨近五百米處時追近至中間位置。保持佳勢至終點，於末段取得第四名。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W4W) Taken back from gate 13, raced at tail, 6 lengths back turning in, taken wide in straight and made some headway.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W4W) 自第十三檔出閘後留居包尾位置。入直路時落後六個馬位。直路上移出外疊，略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W3W) Shifted out and bumped exiting stalls, raced in rear, pushed along wide into home straight, made up some late ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W3W) 出閘時向外斜跑及被碰撞，居後列。入直路時受推策，走外疊。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W3W) Settled midfield 2 wide, closed off strongly to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W3W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。末段衝刺強勁，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W3W) Settled towards rear, switched out rounding the Turn, made steady ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W3W) 居後列。轉直路彎時向外移出。末段以穩勢追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Rail position in rear of mid-field, pushed along 500m out, challenged up rail from 200m out, one paced under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。五百米處受推策。自二百米處起沿內欄展開挑戰。在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Moderately away from gate 1, raced slightly behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, made no impression in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘普通，居中間稍後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (1W1W1W) In rear after badly crowded exiting stalls, blocked off turning into home straight, unable to improve position.
(Roarer again.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(1W1W1W) 出閘時嚴重受擠迫，其後居後列。轉入直路時受困。末段未能追前。
（再次患有喘鳴症。）
